title: Delhi braces for more protests as 'cockroach' group's leaders released
english: A court in Delhi has ordered the release of leaders from the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party following their detention during a massive crackdown on planned protests. The group is advocating for electoral reforms and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner ahead of upcoming state elections. Despite the release, the city remains on high alert with heavy security presence and restrictions to prevent further demonstrations.
amharic: የዴልሂ ፍርድ ቤት በታቀዱ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ወቅት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉትን የኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ መሪዎች እንዲፈቱ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል። ቡድኑ መጪውን የክልል ምርጫ ተከትሎ የምርጫ ማሻሻያዎችን እንዲደረጉ እና ዋናው የምርጫ ኮሚሽነር ከስልጣናቸው እንዲነሱ በመጠየቅ ላይ ይገኛል። መሪዎቹ ቢፈቱም፣ ተጨማሪ ሰልፎችን ለመከላከል በከተማዋ ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ጥበቃና እገዳዎች ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Dehlii hoogganoonni garee 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu kanneen qabsoo karoorfame irratti hidhaman akka gadhiifaman ajajeera. Gareen kun filannoo naannoo dhufuuf jiruun dura fooyya'iinsa sirna filannoo fi murtaa'aan komishinii filannoo hojii irraa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataa jira. Hoogganoonni kunneen gadhiifamanis, magaalaan sun qabsoo itti aanu ittisuuf jecha humna nageenyaa fi uggura cimaa jala jirti.

title: Flash flood sweeps away buildings in Nepal
english: A sudden landslide in Nepal's Gorkha district triggered severe flash flooding along the Budhi Gandaki River on Sunday. The rushing water destroyed several homes and a bridge, leaving local residents terrified. Bystanders captured footage of the destruction from safe vantage points as the floodwaters swept through the area.
amharic: በኔፓል ጎርካ አውራጃ የተከሰተ የመሬት መንሸራተት በቡዲ ጋንዳኪ ወንዝ ላይ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ አስከትሏል። ይህ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን እና ድልድዮችን ጠራርጎ በመውሰዱ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ፈጥሯል። በአካባቢው የነበሩ ሰዎች ጥፋቱን ከፍታ ቦታ ሆነው በቪዲዮ ቀርጸውታል።
oromo: Naannoo Gorkhaa kan biyya Neeppaalitti, lafti sigiguun isaa lagni Budhi Gaandaakii akka guutuufi lolaa cimaa akka uumu godheera. Lolaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi daandii cehuu hedduu barbadeessuun, namoota naannichaa rifachiiseera. Namoonni lolaa kana arguuf carrooman, miidhaa cimaa geessise kana iddoo mijataa irraa viidiyoon waraabaniiru.

title: Vinicius apologises for hair-pull red card but could miss El Clasico
english: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr. has apologized after receiving a red card for pulling an opponent's hair during a match against Villarreal. Although his team won, the goal he scored was overturned following a VAR review that identified his violent conduct. He now faces a potential suspension of up to three games, which could cause him to miss the highly anticipated El Clasico match against Barcelona.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ አጥቂ ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር በቪያሪያል ላይ በተደረገው ጨዋታ የተጋጣሚውን ተጫዋች ፀጉር በመሳቡ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ ከተሰናበተ በኋላ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ምንም እንኳን ቡድኑ ቢያሸንፍም፣ ያስቆጠረው ግብ የቪዲዮ ረዳት ዳኛ (VAR) ጥሰቱን በማረጋገጡ ተሰርዟል። ተጫዋቹ እስከ ሶስት ጨዋታዎች ሊታገድ ስለሚችል፣ በሁለት ሳምንት ውስጥ ከባርሴሎና ጋር በሚደረገው ኤል ክላሲኮ ጨዋታ ላይ የመሰለፍ እድሉ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaataan gubbaa Real Madrid Vinicius Jr. tapha Villarreal waliin taasisaniin mormituu isaa harkaan qabachudhaan kaardii diimaa erga fudhatee booda dhiifama gaafateera. Injifannoo gareen isaa argate iyyuu, gooliin inni galche gargaaraa teeknikaa (VAR) gocha hammeenyaa raawwachuu isaa mirkaneessuudhaan haqameera. Amma adabbiin tapha sadii isatti murteeffachuu danda'a, kunis tapha guddaa 'El Clasico' jedhamu kan Barcelona waliin taasifamu akka inni hin hirmaanne gochuu danda'a.

title: How genocidal war on Gaza is shaping Israel’s election
english: As Israel nears its 2026 general election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is centering his campaign on national security and the ongoing war in Gaza. Analysts observe that the conflict has pushed Israeli politics further to the right, normalizing extreme views regarding Palestinians. Despite facing criticism for his past security failures and the status of captives, Netanyahu continues to frame himself as the only leader capable of protecting the nation from various perceived threats.
amharic: እስራኤል ወደ 2026 አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ስትቃረብ፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የዘመቻቸውን ዋና ትኩረት በብሔራዊ ደህንነት እና በጋዛው ጦርነት ላይ አድርገዋል። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ጦርነት የእስራኤልን ፖለቲካ ወደ ቀኝ በማዘንበል፣ በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የሚወሰዱ እጅግ አስከፊ አቋሞችን ወደ መደበኛ አስተሳሰብ ቀይሯቸዋል። ኔታንያሁ ባለፈው ጊዜ በነበሩ የደህንነት ጉድለቶች እና ታጋቾችን በማስለቀቅ ረገድ ቢተቹም፣ ሀገሪቱን ከስጋቶች ለመጠበቅ ብቸኛው ሰው እርሳቸው ብቻ እንደሆኑ በማስመሰል ዘመቻቸውን እየገፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Israa'el gara filannoo biyyoolessaa bara 2026itti siqaa jirtu kanaan, muummeen ministiraa Benjamin Netanyahu xiyyeeffannoo duula filannoo isaanii nageenya biyyaa fi waraana Gaazaarratti godhataniiru. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni Gaazaa siyaasa Israa'el gara mirgaatti akka caalaa siqee, ilaalcha qindoominaa fi hammeenyaa qaban paalestinootarratti akka babal'atu godheera. Netanyahu darbeen darbe rakkoolee nageenyaa fi dhimma booji'amtootaa ilaalchisee qeeqamanii kan jiran ta'us, biyyattii balaa gara garaa irraa ittisuuf namni dandeettii qabu isa qofa akka ta'e dubbachuun duulasaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: US opens antitrust probe into TV networks for halting Trump coverage
english: The U.S. Department of Justice has launched an antitrust investigation into several major television networks, including CNN, ABC, CBS, NBC, and Fox News. This probe examines whether the networks violated federal law by collectively stopping their coverage of President Trump following his administration's decision to revoke press credentials for certain journalists. The government is questioning if this coordinated boycott constitutes an illegal practice among competitors under the Sherman Act.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር እንደ ሲኤንኤን፣ ኤቢሲ፣ ሲቢኤስ፣ ኤንቢሲ እና ፎክስ ኒውስ ባሉ ዋና ዋና የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያዎች ላይ የፀረ-እምነት ምርመራ ጀምሯል። ምርመራው የተጀመረው ጣቢያዎቹ የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በጋዜጠኞች ላይ የወሰደውን የእገዳ እርምጃ በመቃወም የጋራ የዜና ሽፋን ማቆማቸው ህጋዊ መሆኑን ለማጣራት ነው። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህ የተቀናጀ የዜና ሽፋን ማቆም እርምጃ በውድድር ህግ ላይ የተደነገገውን የፀረ-እምነት ደንብ የጣሰ ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየመረመሩ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbilee oduu gurguddoo kanneen akka CNN, ABC, CBS, NBC fi Fox News irratti qorannoo seeraan alaa eegaleera. Qorannoon kun kan xiyyeeffatu, dhaabbileen kunniin bulchiinsi Pirezidaant Traamp gaazexeessitoota irratti tarkaanfii erga fudhate booda, gabaasa oduu isaanii walta'uun dhaabuun isaanii seeraa ala ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuufidha. Mootummaan, tarkaanfiin kun dorgommii gabaa fi seera 'Sherman Act' kan cabsu ta'uu isaa sakatta'aa jira.

title: Hurricane Isaias kills four, leaves 650,000 without power in Florida
english: Hurricane Isaias has caused four fatalities and disrupted electricity for over 650,000 residents in Florida. The city of Pensacola experienced significant damage, and authorities are advising people to remain cautious as heavy rainfall continues to pose a major flood risk. Restoration efforts for the power grid are ongoing while emergency services address the aftermath of the storm.
amharic: የኢሳይያስ አውሎ ነፋስ በአራት ሰዎች ሕይወት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን ከ650,000 በላይ የፍሎሪዳ ነዋሪዎች ከኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ውጪ እንዲሆኑ አድርጓል። የፔንሳኮላ ከተማ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው አካባቢዎች አንዷ ስትሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት ሊከሰት የሚችለውን የጎርፍ አደጋ አስጠንቅቀዋል። የኤሌክትሪክ መሠረተ ልማትን ለመጠገን እና በአውሎ ነፋሱ የተጎዱትን ለመርዳት የድንገተኛ ጊዜ ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ነው።
oromo: Hurricane Isaias namoota afur galaafatee akkasumas namoota 650,000 oliif tajaajila ibsaa addaan kuteera. Magaalli Pensaakoolaa miidhaa guddaa kan keessummeessite yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni rooba cimaa ro'aa jiruun guutummaan bishaanii akka uumamuu danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Hojiin tajaajila ibsaa deebisanii dhaabuu fi gargaarsa namoota miidhamanii kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, mootummaan ummata of eeggannoo akka godhan gorsa kennee jira.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: The article argues that while the Pretoria Agreement successfully halted large-scale warfare in Tigray, it failed to resolve the underlying political and structural issues that fueled the conflict. The region currently faces a state of uncertainty, characterized by internal political divisions and a lack of a clear path toward sustainable peace or accountability. Ultimately, the author suggests that Tigray's military achievements have been undermined by a failure to develop a coherent political strategy and unified leadership.
amharic: ጽሁፉ እንደሚያመለክተው የፕሪቶሪያው ስምምነት በትግራይ የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ ጦርነት ቢያቆምም፣ ግጭቱን የፈጠሩትን መሰረታዊ የፖለቲካ እና መዋቅራዊ ችግሮች መፍታት አልቻለም። ክልሉ በአሁኑ ወቅት በውስጣዊ የፖለቲካ መከፋፈል እና ዘላቂ ሰላምን ወይም ተጠያቂነትን የሚያመጣ ግልጽ መንገድ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛል። በስተመጨረሻም፣ የትግራይ ወታደራዊ ድሎች ወጥነት ያለው የፖለቲካ ስትራቴጂ እና የተዋሃደ አመራር ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ውጤታማ እንዳይሆኑ ማድረጉን ጸሃፊው ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Barruun kun akka ibsutti, waliigalteen Pritooriyaa naannoo Tigraay keessatti waraana guddaa dhaabuu danda'us, rakkoolee siyaasaa fi caasaa waraana sanaaf sababa ta'an hiikuu hin dandeenye. Naannichi amma haala gaaffii keessa galche keessa jiraachuun, qoqqoodinsa siyaasaa keessoo fi karaa nagaa waaraa ykn itti gaafatamummaa mirkaneessuuf qophiin jiraachuu dhabuun ibsama. Guduunfaadhaan, barreessaan kun injifannoon waraanaa Tigraay, tarsiimoo siyaasaa cimaa fi hoogganummaa tokko ta'e dhabuun akka laafaatetti ibsa.

title: INTEREST INCOME LIFTS ABYSSINIA BANK TO 15.85B BR
english: The Bank of Abyssinia reported a strong financial performance for the 2025/26 fiscal year, with pre-tax profits rising by nearly 57% to 15.85 billion Birr. This growth was primarily fueled by significant increases in interest income, deposits, and total assets. Consequently, the bank's earnings per share improved, and shareholders are expected to receive dividends despite challenging economic conditions.
amharic: የአቢሲኒያ ባንክ የ2025/26 የሒሳብ ዓመት አፈጻጸሙን ይፋ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ከታክስ በፊት የነበረው ትርፍ በ57 በመቶ ገደማ በማደግ 15.85 ቢሊዮን ብር ደርሷል። የዚህ ከፍተኛ እድገት ዋና ምንጭ ከወለድ የተገኘ ገቢ፣ የተቀማጭ ገንዘብ መጠን እና የጠቅላላ ንብረት ጭማሪ ነው። በዚህም የተነሳ የአክሲዮን ተመላሽ መጠን የተሻለ ሆኗል፤ ባንኩም ፈታኝ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም ለባለአክሲዮኖች የትርፍ ድርሻ ለመክፈል አቅዷል።
oromo: Baankiin Abisiniyaa bu’aa qabeessa ta’uu isaa gabaasa baajata bara 2025/26 irratti ibseera; bu’aan isaanii duraan gibira hin kafalamin dhibbeentaa 57 ol dabaluun gara biiliyoona 15.85 ga’eera. Guddina kanaaf sababa guddaan galii dhala baankii, kaffaltii qusannoo fi qabeenya waliigalaa dabaluu isaati. Bu’aa kana irraa ka’uun, gatiin qooda tokkoon tokkoon hirmaattotaa dabaleera; akkasumas, haala diinagdee cimaa keessa iyyuu baankiin hirmaattotaaf qooda bu’aa kaffaluuf qophii ta’uun isaa ibsameera.

title: A Terminal Built for Order Leaves Commuters Walking
english: The new Bole minibus terminal is causing significant congestion because it forces taxis traveling to Mexico and Arat Kilo to use a single entry and exit point. Drivers and traffic staff are struggling with the cramped conditions, which lead to frequent delays during busy hours. Furthermore, the facility is underutilized as only a portion of the minibus routes have been relocated there.
amharic: የአዲሱ የቦሌ ሚኒባስ ተርሚናል አንድ መውጫና መግቢያ ብቻ መሆኑ ለትራፊክ መጨናነቅ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ሜክሲኮና አራት ኪሎ የሚሄዱ ታክሲዎች በተጨናነቀው ቦታ በመገኘታቸው ሾፌሮችና የትራፊክ ተቆጣጣሪዎች ለችግር ተዳርገዋል። ተርሚናሉ ጥቂት መስመሮችን ብቻ በማስተናገዱ ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራ ላይ አለመዋሉ ሌላው ችግር ነው።
oromo: Buufanni konkolaataa minibasiin haaraan Bolee, seenuufi ba'uuf balbala tokko qofatti gargaaramuun isaa guutummaa guututti tiraafikii walitti cufaa jira. Kuniis konkolaattota gara Meeksikoo fi Arat Kiiloo imalan jidduutti rakkoo fi harkifannaa uumaa jira. Haalli kun hojjettootaa fi konkolaachiftotaaf baay'ee rakkisaa ta'ee jira, akkasumas buufatichi guutummaatti akka hin fayyadamneef karaaleen muraasni qofa achi jijjiiramuun isaa rakkoo biraadha.

title: Global Climate Summit Bets on Unfinished Apartments to House the World
english: Organizers for the upcoming COP32 climate conference are working to address housing shortages for international guests by utilizing unfinished apartment buildings. A collaborative effort involving government officials, hotel owners, and developers is identifying projects in Addis Ababa, Bishoftu, and Adama that are at least halfway complete. These sites will be assessed for structural safety and renovated to meet international hospitality standards to serve as temporary accommodations.
amharic: የ32ኛው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ኮንፈረንስ (COP32) አዘጋጆች ለዓለም አቀፍ ተሳታፊዎች የሚሆን ማረፊያ ለማዘጋጀት በመገንባት ላይ ያሉ አፓርታማዎችን ለመጠቀም አቅደዋል። መንግስት፣ የሆቴል ባለቤቶች እና የሪል ስቴት ገንቢዎች በአዲስ አበባ፣ በቢሾፍቱ እና በአዳማ ከተሞች ከግማሽ በላይ የተጠናቀቁ የህንጻ ፕሮጀክቶችን እየለዩ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ህንጻዎች ለዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በሚመጥን መልኩ ተሟልተው ለተሳታፊዎች ጊዜያዊ መኖሪያነት እንዲውሉ እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Qindeessitoonni walgahii jijjiirama qilleensaa kan COP32, hirmaattota biyya alaa keessummeessuuf mana jireenyaa hanqate guutuuf ijaarsa isaa walakkaa irra jiru fayyadamuuf karoorfataniiru. Mootummaan, abbootii qabeenyaa hotelaa fi ijaartotni wal ta'uun, magaalaa Finfinnee, Bishoftuu fi Adaamaa keessatti ijaarsa isaa harka 50 ol gahe qorachaa jiru. Manneen kun qulqullinaa fi sadarkaa addunyaa eeggatanii qophaa'uudhaan, yeroo walgahichaa keessummootaaf akka mana jireenyaatti tajaajilu.

title: Federal Judges Spare Lawyers the Bond as VAT Battle Moves to the Merits
english: A panel of federal judges has halted the enforcement of a government mandate that would have required lawyers to register for Value Added Tax (VAT). The court ruled that the group of lawyers challenging the policy does not need to pay a financial bond during the legal proceedings. This decision was reached after the Federal Supreme Court directed the lower court to assess whether a security deposit was necessary, with the judges concluding that the government faces no significant risk from the suspension.
amharic: የፌዴራል ዳኞች ቡድን ጠበቆች ለተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ (VAT) መመዝገብ አለባቸው የሚለውን የመንግስት መመሪያ ተግባራዊ እንዳይሆን አግደዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን መመሪያ የተቃወሙ ጠበቆች በክርክሩ ሂደት ውስጥ የገንዘብ ዋስትና እንዲያስይዙ አላስገደዳቸውም። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የፌዴራል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ጉዳዩን ዳግም መርምሮ ዋስትና እንደሚያስፈልግ እንዲወስን ካዘዘ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ዳኞቹም መመሪያውን ማገዳቸው በመንግስት ላይ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንደማያስከትል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa federaalaa, abbootiin seeraa gibira dabaltii gatii (VAT) akka galmeessisan dirqisiisuun ture dhaabanii jiru. Mana murtichaa kan murteesse, gareen abbootii seeraa mormii kana qaban adeemsa seeraa keessatti qabxii maallaqaa ykn 'bond' kaffaluu akka hin barbaanneedha. Murtoon kun kan darbe Manni Murtii Waliigalaa Federaalaa mormiin kun akka ilaalamu erga ajajee booda yoo ta'u, abbootiin seeraa mormicha dhaabuun mootummaa irratti miidhaa guddaa akka hin qabne ibsanii jiru.

title: A Cabinet Approved Unanimously, Retained Conditionally
english: The Ethiopian Parliament unanimously approved Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's new Cabinet during a brief session on October 8, 2026. The appointment process concluded without any objections or opposition from the lawmakers present. This decision marks a significant step in the administration's political agenda for the current term.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፓርላማ በጥቅምት 28 ቀን 2019 ዓ.ም በተካሄደ አጭር ስብሰባ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዐቢይ አሕመድን አዲሱን ካቢኔ በአንድ ድምፅ አፀደቀ። የሹመት አሰጣጥ ሂደቱ በምክር ቤት አባላት ምንም አይነት ተቃውሞ ሳይነሳበት በአዎንታዊ መልኩ ተጠናቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በመንግስት የአሁኑ የሥራ ዘመን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ውስጥ ትልቅ ሚና ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Parlamaan Itoophiyaa mudde 28, 2019 walga'ii gabaabaa ta'een kabiinee haaraa Muummicha Ministeeraa Abiy Ahmed sagalee guutuun raggaasee jira. Adeemsi muudamichaa kun miseensota mana marichaa biratti mormii tokko malee xumurameera. Murteen kun waggaa hojii mootummaa ammaa kana keessatti ajandaa siyaasaa isaanii irratti tarkaanfii barbaachisaa dha.

title: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
english: Young men in Myanmar are living in constant fear of being abducted from the streets and forced into military service as the junta struggles to fill its recruitment quotas. Following a mandatory conscription law enacted after significant military losses, authorities are using aggressive tactics, including arbitrary arrests, to replenish their ranks. Many youths are now fleeing the country or hiding indoors to avoid being captured and sent to the front lines of the ongoing civil war.
amharic: በማያንማር የሚገኙ ወጣቶች ወታደራዊው መንግስት የቅጥር ኮታውን ለማሟላት በሚያደርገው የኃይል እርምጃ ምክንያት ከመንገድ እየተጠለፉ ወደ ጦር ሰራዊት እንዲገቡ በመገደድ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። አገዛዙ በደረሰበት ከፍተኛ ኪሳራ ሳቢያ የግዴታ ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ህግን ካወጀ በኋላ፣ ባለስልጣናት ወጣቶችን በዘፈቀደ በመያዝ ወደ ጦርነት እየላኩ ነው። በዚህም የተነሳ ብዙ ወጣቶች ከሀገር እየሸሹ ወይም ሊጠለፉ ይችላሉ በሚል ስጋት ከቤት እንዳይወጡ ተገድደዋል።
oromo: dargaggoonni Myanmar keessatti mootummaan waraanaa quotaa isaa guuttachuuf jecha daandii irraa isaan butuun gara waraanaatti isaan ergaa waan jiruuf soda guddaa keessa jiru. Mootummaan kun injifatama isatti dhufu erga qunnameen booda seera dirqamaa waraanaa baasee, qaamonni nageenyaa dargaggoota humnaan qabuun gara dirree waraanaatti isaan ergaa jiru. Kana irraa kan ka'e, dargaggoonni baay'een biyyaa baqachaa ykn soda butamuu irraa kan ka'e mana keessatti dhokatanii jiraatu.

title: Ebola spreads in eastern DRC as Kenya confirms imported case
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a new region, raising the total number of infections to thousands. Tragically, an imported case was also confirmed in Kenya, where a patient who traveled from the DRC passed away shortly after arrival. Authorities in Kenya and Uganda are now actively tracing contacts and strengthening surveillance to prevent the virus from spreading further.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ወደ አዲስ አካባቢ በመዛመቱ የተጠቂዎች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል። በአስከፊ ሁኔታም ከኮንጎ ወደ ኬንያ የተጓዘ አንድ ግለሰብ በበሽታው ተይዞ በኬንያ ህይወቱ ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የኬንያ እና የዩጋንዳ ባለስልጣናት የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር በንቃት እየሰሩ እና የተጋለጡ ሰዎችን የመከታተል ስራ እያከናወኑ ነው።
oromo: Dhibee vaayirasii Ebola biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiru gara naannawaa haaraatti kan ce'e yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi namoota qabamanii kumaatamaan lakkaa'ama. Akkuma kanaan, namni Koongoo irraa gara Keeniyaatti imale tokko vaayirasichi erga itti argamee booda du'uun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Biyyoonni Keeniyaa fi Yugaandaa dhibichi akka hin babal'anneef namoota dhukkubsataa sana waliin qunnamtii qaban hordofuu fi to'annoo cimaa gochuu jalqabaniiru.

title: Iran war live: 12 killed in Riyadh, US weighs joining fight against Houthis
english: A deadly drone strike on Riyadh’s King Khalid airport has resulted in 12 deaths and over 300 injuries, including the death of an American citizen. In response, the United States is currently considering military intervention against the Houthis and the potential resumption of strikes on Iran. Saudi-led forces have already begun retaliatory actions by intercepting additional hostile drones in the region.
amharic: በሪያድ ንጉስ ካሊድ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት 12 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ300 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ በአደጋው አንድ አሜሪካዊም ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህንን ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በሁቲዎች እና በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ መውሰድን እያሰበች ነው። የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎችም በበኩላቸው ወደ አካባቢው የተላኩ ሌሎች ድሮኖችን መትተው ጥለዋል።
oromo: Buufata xiyyaaraa King Khalid kan Riyaaditti haleellaa dhooyitii (drone) qaqqabeen namoonni 12 du'anii 300 ol immoo miidhamaniiru; namoota miidhaman keessaa lammiin Ameerikaa tokko du'uun mirkanaa'eera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, mootummaan Ameerikaa garee Huutii fi biyya Iraan irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf mari'achaa jira. Gamtaan Sa'udii geggeessus qilleensa irra qindaa'uun daandii kanneen biroo irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu eegaleera.

title: Liverpool vs Man City: the top five clashes between Premier League giants
english: Liverpool and Manchester City are set to face off this Sunday at Anfield in a highly anticipated Premier League match. While Liverpool holds a better historical record against their rivals, Manchester City enters this contest in superior form and sits at the top of the league standings. This upcoming fixture marks the 202nd meeting between these two football giants, continuing a intense modern-day rivalry.
amharic: ሊቨርፑል እና ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በዚህ እሁድ በአንፊልድ በሚደረግ ከፍተኛ ግምት በተሰጠው የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ይገናኛሉ። ሊቨርፑል በታሪክ ከማንቸስተር ሲቲ ጋር ሲጫወት የተሻለ ውጤት ያለው ቢሆንም፣ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ግን ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በሊጉ የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ አናት ላይ በመቀመጥ እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ ብቃት ላይ ይገኛል። ይህ ጨዋታ በሁለቱ ታላላቅ ክለቦች መካከል የሚደረግ 202ኛው ግንኙነት ሲሆን፣ የሁለቱ ቡድኖች የረዥም ጊዜ ፉክክር የሚቀጥልበት ይሆናል።
oromo: Liiverpuul fi Maanchastar Siiti Dilbata dhufu kana dirree Aanfiild irratti tapha guddicha Pirimiyar Liigii irratti wal morkatu. Liiverpuul seenaan yoo ilaallamu sadarkaa gaarii qabaatus, amma garuu Maanchastar Siiti sadarkaa liiigichaa irratti dursuun bifa gaarii irratti argama. Taphi kun walga'ii walakkaa jaarraa fi lamaffaa (202ffaa) garee lamaan gidduutti godhamu ta'ee, morkii cimaa yeroo dheeraa itti fufsiisa.

title: WHO says no plague case registered after Russian lab worker’s death
english: The World Health Organization has reported that no cases of plague have been confirmed following the death of a laboratory worker in Russia. Although there was initial concern regarding the worker's mysterious pneumonia, tests for dangerous pathogens returned negative for her and her contacts. Currently, there is no evidence of an outbreak or further disease transmission, though the exact cause of her death remains unknown.
amharic: በሩሲያ በሚገኝ የላቦራቶሪ ተቋም ውስጥ ሰርታ የነበረች ሰራተኛ ህይወት ካለፈች በኋላ፣ የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ምንም አይነት የቸነፈር (plague) በሽታ አለመመዝገቡን አስታውቋል። የሟችዋ የሳምባ ምች ህመም መነሻ ምን እንደሆነ ባይታወቅም፣ ለተደረጉ የላቦራቶሪ ምርመራዎች እርሷም ሆነ ንክኪ የነበራቸው ሰዎች ውጤት አሉታዊ ሆኗል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ምንም አይነት የበሽታ መስፋፋት ምልክት ባይታይም፣ የሞት መንስኤዋ በውል አለመታወቁ እንደ ዋና እርግጠኛ አለመሆን ተወስዷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa gabaasa akka ibsetti, hojjattoota laaboraatoorii Raashiyaa keessaa tokko erga du'anii booda dhibee vaayirasii 'plague' jedhamu kan hin galmaa'in ta'uu beeksiseera. Hojjattuu tun dhibee sombaa ishee mudateen du'us, ishee fi namoonni ishee wajjin wal quunnamtii qaban qorannoo dhibee kanaaf godhame keessatti virusichi isaan keessatti argamuu baateera. Yeroo ammaa kana dhibeen kun kan babal'ate ykn namoota biroo bira darbe agarsiisuun kan hin jirre yoo ta'u, garuu sababni sirrii inni du'aaf sababa ta'e ammaaf hin baramne.

title: Yemeni government’s military says its forces advancing against Houthis
english: The Yemeni government military claims to have killed over 1,150 Houthi fighters during intense nationwide operations over the past day. Military officials reported destroying significant amounts of enemy weaponry and transport vehicles while continuing their ground offensive. Meanwhile, tensions have escalated further due to a recent attack on a Saudi Arabian airport and threats from the Houthis to target international interests.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት ጦር ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ ባደረገው መጠነ ሰፊ ኦፕሬሽን ከ1,150 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን መግደሉን አስታውቋል። የየመን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች በኦፕሬሽኑ ወቅት በርካታ የጠላት የጦር መሳሪያዎችና የተሽከርካሪዎች መውደማቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት እና የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ላይ የሰነዘሩት ማስፈራሪያ በክልሉ ያለው ግጭት እንዲባባስ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen waraanni isaa sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti loltoota Huutii 1,150 ol ajjeesuu isaa ibseera. Qondaalonni waraanaa tarkaanfii kanaan meeshaalee waraanaa fi konkolaataalee diinaa hedduu barbadeessuunsaanii beekameera. Gama biraatiin, haleellaa buufata xiyyaaraa Saudii Arabaa irratti raawwatamee fi Huutoonni dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa irratti sodaachisa gochuu isaaniitiin walqabatee rakkoon naannichaa hamachaa jira.

title: Real Madrid beat Villarreal 1-0 but Vinicius sent off for hair pull
english: Real Madrid secured a narrow 1-0 victory against Villarreal thanks to a goal from Yan Diomande. Despite the win, Madrid player Vinicius Junior received a red card for pulling an opponent's hair following a VAR review. The result keeps Real Madrid in the hunt for the La Liga title, currently sitting in third place behind leaders Barcelona and Atletico Madrid.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ በያን ዲዮማንዴ ግብ ቪያሪያልን 1 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ ወሳኝ ድል አስመዝግቧል። ሆኖም የቡድኑ አጥቂ ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር የተጋጣሚውን ተጫዋች ፀጉር በመሳቡ ከሜዳ በቀይ ካርድ ተሰናብቷል። ይህ ድል ሪያል ማድሪድ በሊጉ ደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ በባርሴሎና እና በአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ በመከተል ሶስተኛ ደረጃ ላይ እንዲቀመጥ አስችሎታል።
oromo: Ri'aal Maadriid goolii Yaann Diomaande galeen Viyaariyaal 1-0 mo'achuu danda'eera. Ta'us, taphataan maadriid Viinisius Juuniyer mormituu isaa rifeensa harkisuun kaardii diimaa argatee dirree irraa ari'ameera. Injifannoon kun Ri'aal Maadriid liigii Laa Liigaa keessatti sadarkaa sadaffaa irra akka jiraatu fi abbootii duraa Baarseloonaa fi Atleetikoo Maadriid hordofaa akka jiru taasiseera.

title: Hundreds of doctors demand World Medical Association suspend Israel
english: Hundreds of medical professionals gathered at a World Medical Association summit in the Netherlands to demand the suspension of the Israeli Medical Association. Protesters argue that the Israeli organization has failed to condemn the destruction of healthcare infrastructure in Gaza and the detainment of Palestinian medical workers. The group accused their Israeli counterparts of being complicit in human rights violations rather than upholding professional ethical standards.
amharic: በኔዘርላንድስ በተካሄደው የአለም የህክምና ማህበር ስብሰባ ላይ በመገኘት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የእስራኤል የህክምና ማህበር ከማህበሩ እንዲታገድ ጠይቀዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የእስራኤል ማህበር በጋዛ የጤና ተቋማት መውደም እና የፍልስጤም የጤና ሰራተኞች መታሰር ላይ ዝምታን በመምረጡ ተጠያቂ መሆን አለበት ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። የህክምና ባለሙያዎቹ የእስራኤል አቻዎቻቸው የሙያ ስነ-ምግባርን በመጣስ ለሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ተባባሪ ናቸው ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል።
oromo: Ogeeyyoonni fayyaa dhibbaan lakkaa’aman biyya Neezarlaanditti walga’ii Gamtaa Fayyaa Addunyaarratti argamuun, Gamtaan Fayyaa Israa’el miseensummaa isaa akka dhaabu gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni kun, gamtaan Israa’el diigamu buuuraalee fayyaa Gaazaa fi hidhamuu ogeeyyota fayyaa Falasxiin irratti mormii dhabuu isaa mormaniiru. Ogeeyyoonni fayyaa kunneen, hordoftoonni Israa’el kun qajeelfama fayyaa cabsuun sarbamuu mirga namoomaa keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin himataniiru.

title: Malawi motorists queue for days as fuel shortage bites
english: Malawi is experiencing a severe fuel crisis that has forced drivers in Lilongwe to wait in long lines for several days, with many sleeping in their vehicles. The scarcity of petrol has significantly disrupted daily life, preventing people from reaching their jobs and schools. Consequently, local businesses are suffering as the lack of transport prevents customers from accessing services.
amharic: በማላዊ የነዳጅ እጥረት በመከሰቱ በዋና ከተማዋ ሊሎንግዌ የሚገኙ አሽከርካሪዎች ለቀናት በረዥም ወረፋ እንዲጠብቁ አስገድዷቸዋል። የነዳጅ እጥረቱ የዕለት ተዕለት እንቅስቃሴን በማስተጓጎሉ ሰዎች ወደ ሥራ እና ትምህርት ቤት ለመሄድ ተቸግረዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት የትራንስፖርት እጥረት በመኖሩ የንግድ ተቋማት ደንበኞቻቸውን በማጣት ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Maalaawwii keessatti hanqinni boba'aa cimaan mudatee jiraachuu isaa hordofee, konkolaachiftonni magaalaa guddoo Lilongwe keessa jiran guyyoota hedduuf hiriira dheeraa keessa turuun dirqamee jira. Hanqinni kun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa guutummaatti dhaabuun, namoonni hojii fi mana barnootaa dhaquu akka hin dandeenye godheera. Kanaan walqabatee, namoonni geejjiba dhabuu isaaniitiin daldaltoonni naannichaa maamiltoota dhabuun isaanii miidhaa cimaa irra gahee jira.

title: Hurricane Simon strengthens to Category 4 off Mexico’s Pacific coast
english: Hurricane Simon has intensified into a Category 4 storm and is heading toward Mexico's Pacific coast with dangerous winds and heavy rain. Authorities have issued warnings for areas near Manzanillo and Puerto Vallarta, urging residents to prepare for severe flooding and potential mudslides. Emergency evacuations and school closures are underway as the region braces for the storm's expected landfall over the weekend.
amharic: አውሎ ንፋስ ሳይመን ወደ ምድብ አራት ደረጃ በማደግ ወደ ሜክሲኮ የፓስፊክ የባህር ጠረፍ እየተመመ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት በሰው እና በንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ሊያደርስ የሚችለውን ከፍተኛ ዝናብ እና ጎርፍ በመስጋት በባህር ዳርቻው አካባቢ ያሉ ነዋሪዎች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ትምህርት ቤቶች ተዘግተው የነዋሪዎች መልቀቅ ስራ የተጀመረ ሲሆን አካባቢውም አውሎ ንፋሱ በሚያመጣው ተጽእኖ ለከባድ አደጋ ተጋልጧል።
oromo: Hurricane Simon gara sadarkaa afurtti guddatee gara qarqara galaana Paasifiikii kan biyya Meeksikootti imalaa jira. Aangoonni biyyattii rooba cimaa fi lolaa du’aafi miidhaa geessisuu danda’u sodaatanii, namootni naannoo Manzaniiloo fi Puerto Vallarta jiran akka of eeggannoo godhan hubachiisaniiru. Barnootni dhaabatee namootni bakka gaaraa jiran gara bakka tasgabbaa’aatti akka godaannaf kan taasifame yoo ta’u, miidhaan guddaan akka mudatu sodaan jira.

title: Projectile lands near Dammam airport as fresh attack disrupts Riyadh flights
english: Military projectiles have struck near two major airports in Saudi Arabia, specifically impacting locations close to the Dammam and Riyadh international hubs. These security incidents have forced significant disruptions to air travel schedules in the region. Authorities confirmed that these attacks occurred over the weekend, highlighting ongoing security concerns.
amharic: የሳውዲ ዓረቢያ ጥምረት ወታደራዊ አካላት በዳማም እና በሪያድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች አቅራቢያ የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በአካባቢው የሚደረጉ የንግድ በረራዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል አስከትለዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት፣ ክስተቶቹ ቅዳሜ ዕለት የተከሰቱ ሲሆን የደኅንነት ሥጋቶችን የጨመሩ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnootni waraana sa'udii buufataalee xiyyaaraa gurguddoo lama, kanneen Dammaam fi Riyaaditti argaman biratti miidhaa meeshaalee waraanaatiin mudachuu ibsaniiru. Hojiiwwan waraanaa kun adeemsa balaliin xiyyaaraa naannichaa irratti gufuu guddaa uumaniiru. Qondaalonni akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun guyyaa Sanbataa kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, yaaddoo nageenyaa biyyattii irratti dabaleera.

title: IRGC says oil supertanker hit mine in Strait of Hormuz
english: A massive explosion occurred after a crude oil tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s Revolutionary Guard claimed the ship violated safety protocols by disabling its tracking systems and traveling on an unauthorized route. They issued a stern warning that any vessel failing to follow regional security rules will face similar consequences.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አንድ የነዳጅ መርከብ በማዕድን ፈንጂ በመመታቱ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ ተከስቷል። የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች መርከቧ የመከታተያ ስርዓቷን በማጥፋት እና ህገ-ወጥ መስመር በመከተል ደንቦችን እንደጣሰች ገልጸዋል። በክልሉ የደህንነት ህጎችን የማይከተሉ መርከቦች ሁሉ ተመሳሳይ አደጋ እንደሚገጥማቸውም አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hormuz Strait keessatti dooniin boba'aa guddaan tokko mina'idii (mine) keessa bu'uun dhohee jira. Eegdonni daangaa biyya Iran akka jedhanitti, dooniin kun sirna iddoo beekuu isaa cufuudhaan karaa seeraan alaa imalaa akka ture ibsaniiru. Dhaabbanni kun, dooniin kamiyyuu seera nageenyaa naannichaa cabse balaa akkanaa akka qunnamu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Indian carrier keeps Saudi flights suspended until 13 October after airport attack
english: Indian airline Akasa Air has extended the suspension of all flights to Saudi Arabia until October 13. This decision follows recent security concerns and Houthi missile strikes targeting the King Khalid International Airport. The company stated that the pause will continue while they monitor the volatile security situation in the region.
amharic: የሕንድ አየር መንገድ አካሳ ኤር ወደ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሚያደርገውን በረራ እስከ ጥቅምት 13 ድረስ ማራዘሙን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ በተፈጸመው የጥቃት ሙከራ እና በአካባቢው ባለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ምክንያት ነው። አየር መንገዱ በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ስጋት እስኪረጋጋ ድረስ በረራዎቹ ታግደው እንደሚቆዩ ገልጿል።
oromo: Hawaanxoon Indiyaa Akasa Air balalii gara Sa'udii Arabiyaa godhu hanga Fulbaana 13tti dheeressuuf murteesseera. Murtoon kun kan dhufeyyu buufata xiyyaaraa King Khalid irratti haleellaa raawwatamee fi haala nageenyaa naannichaa hordofee dha. Dhaabbatichi haalli nageenyaa naannichaa ammaaf waan hin mijanneef hanga guyyaa jedhameetti balaliin dhaabbatee akka turu beeksiseera.

title: Qatar’s former PM urges decisive support for Saudi Arabia after airport attack
english: Former Qatari Prime Minister Hamad bin Jassim has called for Gulf nations to unite and support Saudi Arabia following a recent attack on an airport. He emphasized that Iran is a primary threat and urged regional neighbors to resolve their internal disputes to counter foreign plots. Al Thani stressed that the security situation requires a strong, unified response from the Gulf Cooperation Council.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሃማድ ቢን ጃሲም፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ከተፈጸመው ጥቃት በኋላ የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት በአንድነት እንዲቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ኢራንን ዋነኛ ስጋት እንደሆነች የገለጹት የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ፣ አገራቱ ለጋራ ደህንነት ሲባል የውስጥ ልዩነቶቻቸውን ወደ ጎን ትተው በቆራጥነት እንዲንቀሳቀሱ አሳስበዋል። ይህ የደህንነት ሁኔታ የባህረ ሰላጤው ትብብር ምክር ቤት አባላት የተቀናጀ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ እንደሚጠይቅም አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Muummichi ministeeraa Qatar duraanii Hamad bin Jassim, erga weerara buufata xiyyaaraa Saudi Arabia irra ga'ee booda biyyoonni naannoo Gulf tokko ta'uun Saudi Arabia akka deeggaran waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Iraan balaa guddaa akka taate kan ibsan Hamad bin Jassim, biyyoonni naannichaa rakkoo jidduu isaanii jiru hunda hambisuun gara fuulduraatti tokkummaan dhaabachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Haalli nageenyaa amma keessa jirru kun miseensonni gorsa walta'iinsa Gulf (GCC) tarkaanfii waloo fi cimaa akka fudhatan kan dirqisiisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Air France enforces Israeli ban affecting pilots from Muslim countries
english: Air France is now complying with an Israeli mandate that prohibits flight crew members from 31 specific countries, mostly with Muslim majorities, from operating flights into Israel. This policy applies to individuals holding these nationalities, including dual citizens, and follows an alleged security incident involving a pilot on a flight to Tel Aviv. The airline has instructed its staff to report their nationalities or face potential disciplinary action, a move that could lead to legal challenges regarding discrimination.
amharic: ኤር ፍራንስ እስራኤል ባወጣችው አዲስ መመሪያ መሰረት ከ31 ሀገራት የመጡ አብራሪዎች እና የበረራ አስተናጋጆች ወደ እስራኤል በሚደረጉ በረራዎች ላይ እንዳይሳተፉ እገዳ ጥሏል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በቴል አቪቭ በረራ ላይ ተፈጠረ በተባለ የደህንነት ስጋት ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ በዋናነት ሙስሊም አብላጫ ሀገራትን ያካትታል። አየር መንገዱ ሰራተኞች ሁለተኛ ዜግነታቸውን እንዲያሳውቁ ያስገደደ ሲሆን፣ ይህ አሰራር በፈረንሳይ ህግ መሰረት ለህግ ችግር ሊዳርገው ይችላል።
oromo: Air France ajaja mootummaan Israa'el baase kabajuudhaan, biyyoota 31 irraa dhufan kanneen keessumaa muslimoota irra jiran irraa kan dhufan ogeeyyiin balaliisaa fi hojjettoonni qilleensa irraa gara Israa'el akka hin balaliine dhorkeera. Murteen kun kan darbe balaa nageenyaa xiyyaara gara Tel Aviv balali'u irratti uumame jedhamee erga himamee booda. Air France hojjettoota isaa biyya isaanii lammaffaa akka ibsan kan gaafate yoo ta'u, ajaja kana diduun adabbii akka fidu akeekkachiiseera; kunis seera Faransaay waliin wal qabatee qeeqa seeraa isatti fiduu danda'a.

title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
english: US President Donald Trump has publicly suggested that Ukraine needs a new leader after President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized a US deal to ease sanctions on Russian diesel. Trump argued that Ukraine should stop targeting Russian oil refineries because these attacks negatively affect global fuel prices. Meanwhile, Zelensky warned that the deal provides Russia with more revenue to continue its military aggression against his country.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ በሩሲያ የናፍጣ ንግድ ላይ የገቡትን ስምምነት በመተቸታቸው ዩክሬን አዲስ መሪ እንደሚያስፈልጋት ተናገሩ። ትራምፕ የዩክሬን ጥቃት የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን ኢላማ ማድረጉ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር ማድረጉን በመጥቀስ ጥቃቱ እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል። ዘሌንስኪ በበኩላቸው ይህ ስምምነት ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ ለምታካሂደው ጦርነት ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ምንጭ እንደሚሆናት በመግለጽ ስምምነቱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, pirezedaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenskiin waliigaltee Ameerikaan gabaa daayizelii Raashiyaa waliin goote komachuu isaanii hordofee, Yukreen hogganaa haaraa akka barbaaddu dubbataniiru. Tiraamp, Yukreen qulqulleeffattoota boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuu ishii akka dhaabdu kan gaafatan yoo ta'u, kunis gatii boba'aa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jira jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Zeelenskiin waliigalteen kun Raashiyaan Yukreen irratti waraana itti fufuuf maallaqa akka argattu kan gargaaru ta'uu isaa ibsuun waliigalticha balaaleffataniiru.

title: Several injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh
english: A violent attack at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has left several people injured and forced the facility to suspend all flight operations. This incident follows a series of recent strikes attributed to Houthi rebels, prompting various international embassies to warn their citizens to avoid the area. Emergency medical services are currently responding to the situation as authorities work to secure the airport.
amharic: በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፣ ይህም የአየር ማረፊያውን አገልግሎት በሙሉ እንዲቋረጥ አድርጓል። ይህ ጥቃት በቅርቡ በሁቲ አማፂያን ከተፈጸሙ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶች በኋላ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ የተለያዩ ሀገራት ኤምባሲዎች ዜጎቻቸው አካባቢውን እንዲያስወግዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የህክምና ባለሙያዎች እና የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች ጉዳት ለደረሰባቸው ሰዎች እርዳታ በማድረግ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buufata xiyyaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan magaalaa guddoo Saudii Arabiyaa Riyaaditti argamutti haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru; kunis hojii buufatichaa guutummaatti akka dhaabbatu godheera. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe haleellaa garee finxaaleyyii Huutiiwwaniin torbanoota darban keessa raawwatamaa turanii dha; kanaafuu, biyyoonni addaddaa lammiileen isaanii iddoo kana irraa akka fagaatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Yeroo ammaa ogeeyyoonni fayyaa fi tajaajilli hatattamaa miidhamtoota gargaaruuf socho'aa jiru.

title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
english: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, has returned to prison after surviving a failed execution attempt via lethal injection last month. The 50-year-old spent ten days in the hospital in critical condition before recovering enough to be discharged. While she continues to receive medical treatment behind bars, authorities have not confirmed if they will attempt to execute her again. This rare incident has prompted a court order to preserve all evidence regarding the botched procedure for potential legal review.
amharic: በቴነሲ ግዛት የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ፣ ባለፈው ወር በተደረገባት ያልተሳካ የመርዝ መርፌ ግድያ ሙከራ ከተረፈች በኋላ ወደ እስር ቤት ተመልሳለች። የ50 ዓመቷ ፓይክ በሆስፒታል ለተወሰኑ ቀናት በከባድ ሁኔታ ላይ ከቆየች በኋላ አገግማ ወደ እስር ቤት የተመለሰች ቢሆንም፣ ቀጣይ የህክምና ክትትል እያደረገች ነው። ባለስልጣናት ግድያውን እንደገና ለመፈጸም አቅደው እንደሆነ እስካሁን አልገለጹም። ጉዳዩ ያልተለመደ በመሆኑ ፍርድ ቤቱ ለወደፊት ህጋዊ ክርክር እንዲጠቅም ከሙከራው ጋር የተያያዙ ማስረጃዎች ሁሉ እንዲጠበቁ አዟል።
oromo: Adabbii du'aa kan murteeffameef Christa Pike, ji'a darbe yaaliin ajjeechaa sunniin (lethal injection) milkaa'uu dhiisee erga oolee booda gara mana hidhaatti deebiteetti. Umriin ishee waggaa 50 kan ta'e, erga hospitaala keessatti guyyoota kudhan tursiifamtee booda fayyaa argattee gara mana hidhaa kan deebite yoo ta'u, achittis yaala fayyaa argachuu itti fufti. Mootummaan ajjeechaa kana irra deebi'uuf karoorfate ykn hin karoorfanne hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Dhimmi kun kan hin baratamne waan ta'eef, mana murtii irraa ragaaleen yaalii kana waliin walqabatan hundi akka hin badneef ajajameera.

title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
english: Hurricane Isaias struck the southern United States, resulting in four deaths across Alabama and Florida due to fallen trees and storm-related incidents. The powerful storm caused significant destruction to homes and left hundreds of thousands of residents without electricity. Authorities issued emergency declarations and evacuations as they worked to rescue people from flooded areas and manage the dangerous aftermath.
amharic: አውሎ ንፋስ ኢሳይያስ በደቡባዊ አሜሪካ ባደረሰው ጥፋት በአላባማ እና ፍሎሪዳ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ቤቶችን በማፍረስ እና ዛፎችን በመጣል ከስድስት መቶ ሺህ በላይ ለሚሆኑ ሰዎች የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት መቋረጥ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ እና የለቀቃ ትዕዛዝ በመስጠት በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hurricane Isaias biyyaa Ameerikaa gara kibbaa haleeluun lubbuun namoota afur akka darbu godheera. Obbolaan kun kan ta'an jiilaa fi bu'aa obbolaa garaa garaa irraan kan ka'e yemmuu ta'u, mannoota hedduu miidhee fi humna elektirikaa namoota kuma dhibba hedduu irraa kutuun hiraarsuun yaadatama. Mootummaan biyyattii hatattamaan labsiin muddamaa labsuun namoota balaa lolaa keessatti kufan oolchuuf socho'aa jira.

title: Trump calls for new president in Ukraine
english: Donald Trump has publicly expressed that it is time for Ukraine to elect a new leader. He further criticized President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, specifically urging him to end military strikes against Russian oil facilities. These comments highlight ongoing tensions regarding US policy and strategy in the continuing conflict.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዩክሬን አዲስ መሪ እንደሚያስፈልጋት በይፋ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም የዩክሬኑን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪን በመተቸት በሩሲያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ አስተያየቶች በዩክሬን ጦርነት ዙሪያ ያለውን የአሜሪካ የፖሊሲ ልዩነት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Doonaald Tiraamp yeroon isaa ga'eera jechuun Yukireen hoogganaa haaraa filachuu qabdi jedhaniiru. Kana malees, Pirezidaant Volodimiir Zeeleniskiin qeequudhaan, buufataalee qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwatamu dhaabuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Yaanni kun waldhabdee Yukireen keessatti ka'e irratti ilaalcha Ameerikaa garaagarummaa qabu kan calaqqisiisu dha.

title: Palestinians still being killed in Gaza, one year into ‘ceasefire’
english: A full year has passed since a US-mediated ceasefire was established, yet Israeli military strikes against Palestinians in Gaza continue. The region faces a severe humanitarian crisis, characterized by ongoing displacement, restricted access to aid, and the destruction of vital healthcare and education systems. Despite the peace agreement, the local population remains in a state of ongoing conflict and extreme hardship.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አስታራቂነት በተደረገ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አንድ ዓመት ሙሉ ቢያልፍም፣ በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ጥቃቶች መገደላቸው ቀጥሏል። አካባቢው የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እጥረት፣ የተፈናቃዮች መብዛት እንዲሁም የጤና እና የትምህርት ተቋማት ውድመት የገጠመው ከፍተኛ ቀውስ ውስጥ ይገኛል። በስምምነቱ መሰረት ሰላም መስፈን ቢገባውም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ አሁንም በጦርነትና በከባድ ችግሮች ውስጥ መሆናቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa kan Ameerikaan gidduu seente erga mallatteeffamee waggaan tokko guutee jiraatus, haleellaan Israa'el Gaza keessatti namoota irratti raawwatamu hin dhaabanne. Godinichi rakkoo namoomaa cimaa keessa jiru yoo ta'u, namoota baay'een buqqa'uu, gargaarsi namoomaa daangeffamuu fi tajaajilli fayyaa fi barnootaa guutummaatti barbadaa'uu isaan miidhaa irra ga'ee jira. Waliigaltee nageenyaa sana duubas, uummanni Gaza yeroo ammaa kana waraanaa fi rakkoo hamaa keessatti argama.

title: Photos: Thousands march across Europe to demand end to Israel’s war on Gaza
english: Thousands of protesters gathered in major European cities like London, Berlin, and Rome to call for an immediate end to the ongoing conflict in Gaza. Demonstrators criticized their governments' military support for Israel and demanded that comprehensive sanctions be imposed. Despite a supposed ceasefire, participants highlighted that daily strikes continue to cause significant loss of life and destruction in the region.
amharic: በለንደን፣ በበርሊን እና በሮም የሚገኙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጠየቁ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግስታታቸው ለእስራኤል የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በመቃወም አገሪቱ ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጣል አሳስበዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ እስራኤል የምታደርሰው ጥቃት የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት እየቀጠፈ መሆኑን ሰልፈኞቹ አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Magaalota gurguddoo Awurooppaa kanneen akka London, Berlin fi Roomaatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman waraana Gaazaatti geggeeffamaa jiru akka dhaabbatu gaafatan. Hiriiftoonni kun mootummoonni isaanii Israa'el gargaarsa waraanaa gochuun ishee balaaleffachuun, tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan fudhatamuu akka qabu dhaaman. Haata'u malee, walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa jiraatus, Israa'el guyyuu haleellaa geggeessuun lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafachaa jirtu mormaniiru.

title: Attack on airport in Saudi capital, Riyadh, leaves several injured
english: A recent attack at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in multiple injuries and forced a temporary halt to all flight operations. This incident follows another deadly assault at the same location earlier in the week attributed to Houthi rebels. International embassies have issued safety warnings to their citizens, while U.S. officials are currently reviewing the situation to determine a potential response.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ የኤርፖርቱም አገልግሎት ለጊዜው እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በዚሁ ሳምንት መጀመሪያ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ሌላ ገዳይ ጥቃት ማግስት ነው። የውጭ ሀገራት ኤምባሲዎች ለዜጎቻቸው የደህንነት ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ያስጠነቀቁ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስትም በጉዳዩ ላይ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ሁኔታዎችን እየገመገመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Buufata xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan Riyaad, magaalaa guddittii Saudi Arabia keessatti haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru, akkasumas tajaajilli buufatichaa yeroof addaan citeera. Haleellaan kun kan hordofe haleellaa kanaan dura torbanuma kana keessa garee Houthiin raawwatamee fi lubbuu namootaa galaafate dha. Ambaasaadonni biyyoota alaa lammiileen isaanii akka of eeggannoo godhan gorsanii jiru, mootummaan Ameerikaas tarkaanfii itti aanu murteessuuf haalicha hordofaa jira.

title: Nine killed in shooting in US state of Pennsylvania, including two children
english: A tragic shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania, resulted in the deaths of nine people, including two children. The suspect, who barricaded himself inside a home before taking his own life, was found dead along with the other victims when police entered the scene. Local officials described the event as a deeply disturbing and unprecedented tragedy for the community.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ፔንሲልቬኒያ ግዛት በኤሪ ከተማ በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ የተኩስ አደጋ ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ግለሰብ በቤቱ ውስጥ ተደብቆ ከቆየ በኋላ በራሱ ላይ ጥይት ተኩሶ መሞቱ ተረጋግጧል። የአካባቢው የፖሊስ አዛዥ ክስተቱ በከተማዋ ታሪክ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ አሳዛኝ አደጋ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Magaala Erie, kanneen keessatti namoonni sagal, ijoollee lama dabalatee, ajjeechaa rasaasaan raawwatameen lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Ajjeechaa kana booda namni shakkamee ture inni of ajjeese, poolisiin mana sana seenanii yeroo argan du'ee argameera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa fi poolisiin naannichaa, mudannoon kun magaalaa sanaaf kan duraan hin argamne fi baay'ee kan nama gaddisiisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Hundreds of thousands march worldwide against Israel’s genocide in Gaza
english: Hundreds of thousands of protesters gathered across the globe in over 300 coordinated demonstrations to denounce the ongoing military actions in Gaza. Participants in major cities like London, Berlin, and Dublin called for an end to the violence and urged their governments to stop supporting Israeli military operations. Activists emphasized that despite a theoretical ceasefire, civilian casualties continue to mount and essential humanitarian aid remains restricted.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጥቃት በመቃወም በመላው ዓለም በሚገኙ ከተሞች መቶ ሺህ የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። በለንደን፣ በርሊን እና ደብሊን የተካሄዱትን ጨምሮ ከ300 በላይ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በተደረጉ ሰልፎች ተሳታፊዎች በጋዛ የሚፈጸመው ግድያ እንዲቆም እና መንግስታት ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ መስጠታቸውን እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቀዋል። አክቲቪስቶች የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ በተግባር እየሰራ እንዳልሆነ እና የሲቪል ሰዎችን ህይወት ከመቅጠፍ ባሻገር የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ እገዳዎች እንዳሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriirri mormii bal'aan namoota dhibba kumaatamaan lakka'aman hirmaachise, haleellaa Gaza keessatti raawwatamaa jiru mormuuf addunyaa maratti gaggeeffameera. Magaalota gurguddoo akka Landan, Barlin fi Dablin keessatti hiriirtonni haleellaan kun akka dhaabatu fi mootummoonni isaanii gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'eliif kennan akka dhaaban gaafataniiru. Aktivistoonni walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa jiru kan maqaa qofa ta'uu fi namoonni nagaa guyyuu akka ajjeefamaa jiran akkasumas gargaarsi namoomaa akka hin geenye dhorkaa jiru ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Europe's leaders are preparing for war. Workers are organising to stop it
english: European nations are ramping up military preparations and civil defense drills amid rising geopolitical tensions. However, many workers are pushing back against this trend, exemplified by significant strikes at Airbus facilities in Spain. These labor actions are disrupting military production and highlighting a disconnect between government war policies and the priorities of the workforce.
amharic: በአውሮፓ አገራት መካከል ያለው የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ወታደራዊ ዝግጅቶች እና የመከላከያ ልምምዶች ተጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። ይሁን እንጂ በስፔን በሚገኙ የኤርባስ ፋብሪካዎች እየተደረጉ ያሉ የሠራተኞች የሥራ ማቆም አድማዎች ለዚህ አካሄድ ተቃውሞ እያሳዩ ነው። እነዚህ የሠራተኛ ማኅበራት እንቅስቃሴዎች የወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች ምርትን በማስተጓጎል በመንግሥታት የጦርነት ዝግጅት እና በሠራተኞች ፍላጎት መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት አጋልጠዋል።
oromo: biyyoonni Awurooppaa sodaa waraanaa dabalaa dhufuun wal-qabatee qophii waraanaafi leenjii ittisa biyyaa daran cimsaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, hojjettoonni biyyoota gara garaa keessa jiran qophii kana mormuun, keessattuu dhaabbata Eerbaas (Airbus) kan Ispeen keessatti godhamaa jiruun falmaa jiru. Gochaan hojjettootaa kun oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa gufachiiseera akkasumas gidduu mootummootaafi hojjettoota gidduutti wal-dhaba uumame akka jiru ifa godheera.

title: Dozens injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
english: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was closed following an attack attributed to Houthi forces, leading to multiple flight cancellations. The incident resulted in dozens of injuries, with several victims requiring intensive care. Foreign embassies have issued urgent safety warnings, advising their citizens to stay away from the airport area.
amharic: በሪያድ የሚገኘው የኪንግ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ምክንያት ተዘግቷል። ጥቃቱ የበርካታ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአስር የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ጥቂቶቹ በጽኑ ህክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ። የተለያዩ አገራት ኤምባሲዎች ዜጎቻቸው ከአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው አካባቢ እንዲርቁ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Buufanni xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan Riyaad jiru haleellaa garee Houthiitiin raawwatameen wal qabatee cufameera. Haleellaa kanaan wal qabatee balalliiwwan hedduun haquun kan dirqisiise yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduun madaa'anii tokko tokko immoo yaala cimaa keessa jiru. Embaasiwwan biyyoota gara garaa lammiileen isaanii bakka buufata xiyyaaraa kanatti akka hin dhihaanne akeekkachiisa dabarsaniiru.

title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
english: Hundreds of protesters from the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party were detained in Delhi as they attempted to rally for electoral reforms and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner. The group, founded by Abhijeet Dipke, claims that voter lists have been unfairly manipulated to benefit the ruling party. Authorities had denied permission for the demonstration and deployed heavy security, eventually taking the movement's leaders into custody before the event could take place.
amharic: በህንድ ዋና ከተማ ዴሊ፣ የምርጫ ማሻሻያዎችን እና የምርጫ ኮሚሽነሩን ስልጣን መልቀቅ የሚጠይቁ የ'ኮክሮች' ፓርቲ አባላት በፖሊስ ተይዘዋል። ወጣቶች የመሩት ይህ ቡድን፣ የምርጫ ድምጽ ሰጪዎች ዝርዝር ገዢውን ፓርቲ ለመጥቀም በሚያስችል መልኩ የተዛባ መሆኑን በመቃወም ሰልፍ ለማድረግ ሞክረው ነበር። ባለስልጣናት ሰልፉን በመከልከላቸው እና ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ሃይሎችን በማሰማራታቸው፣ የቡድኑ መሪዎች ከመድረሳቸው በፊት በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Deelhiitti miseensoonni garee 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamuu fi jijjiirama sagalee kennuu gaafachaa turan dhibbaan lakkaawwaman poolisiin qabamanii jiru. Gareen dargaggootaan durfamu kun, galmeen sagalee kennitootaa paartii bulchaa jiruuf mijatuuf jedhamee kan jijjiirame ta'uu himuun mormii kaase. Bulchiinsi magaalattii mormii kana hayyamuu dideera, akkasumas humna nageenyaa guddinaan bobbaasuun hogganoota garee kanaa qabee hidheera.

title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
english: A Russian glide bomb attack on residential buildings in the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia has resulted in at least 15 deaths, including three children. Search and rescue teams are currently working to find survivors trapped under the collapsed apartment blocks. President Zelensky criticized the attack, suggesting it occurred after the U.S. eased sanctions on Russian fuel, which he views as an encouragement for continued Russian aggression.

title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
english: A 21-year-old student was arrested in Warsaw after attacking three people with a weapon at her school. This marks the third knife-related incident at a Polish school within a single week, following two other violent attacks that occurred earlier. Authorities are currently investigating whether these incidents are linked to a dangerous online challenge, and police have intensified security measures at schools nationwide.

title: Arsenal beat Leeds 2-1 in comeback win to move level with Man City at top
english: Arsenal secured a 2-1 victory over Leeds United after trailing in the second half, marking their fifth win in six games this season. Riccardo Calafiori equalized for the home team before Bruno Guimaraes netted the winning goal. This important result brings Arsenal level on points with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League table.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli settlers attack olive farmers
english: Israeli settlers have been reported attacking Palestinian farmers and stealing their olive crops during the current harvest season. These violent incidents occurred as the region marked one year since the implementation of a ceasefire in Gaza. The ongoing disruptions have severely impacted the ability of local farmers to safely gather their produce.

title: Mexican judge sentences three men for murders of Australian, US surfers
english: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men for the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend while they were on a surfing trip in Baja California. The victims were killed after being confronted at their campsite, where their belongings were stolen before they were shot. This verdict brings a difficult conclusion for the families who have sought justice since the bodies were discovered in a well two years ago.

title: Why is the US sanctioning the International Criminal Court?
english: The United States has imposed new sanctions on the International Criminal Court, aiming to restrict its financial operations and challenge its authority. Secretary of State Marco Rubio labeled the court as a rogue entity, asserting that American citizens are not subject to its legal oversight. This decision follows the ICC's controversial efforts to investigate high-ranking Israeli officials and US military actions, drawing significant criticism from the current administration.

title: Abbas postpones Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027
english: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas has officially delayed the legislative elections that were scheduled for November, moving them to September 2027. The vote will now be combined with a presidential election on that new date. Officials cited Israeli interference and restricted access in Gaza and the West Bank as the primary reasons for the postponement, arguing that a fair process is currently impossible.

title: Israeli settlers kidnap three Palestinian farmers west of Bethlehem
english: Israeli settlers, supported by military forces, kidnapped three Palestinian farmers and seized their agricultural equipment and crops in the town of Qaffin. This incident is part of a broader wave of violence, with over a dozen reported attacks across multiple regions aimed at displacing Palestinians from their land. These coordinated actions include property theft, physical assaults, and the obstruction of roads.

title: Israeli forces strike southern Lebanon’s Marjayoun district
english: Israeli warplanes conducted an airstrike on the town of Talloussah in southern Lebanon this Saturday. While the area has frequently been a target of such attacks, there is currently no information regarding potential injuries or property damage. This incident is part of a broader series of ongoing military operations in the southern Lebanese region.

oromo: Xiyyaarri waraana Israa'el Dilbata darbe magaalaa Taaluusah kan kibba Libaanositti argamtu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwate. Magaalattiin yeroo hedduu haleellaa kanaaf kan saaxilamtu ta'us, haleellaa kana hordofee miidhaan qaqqabe jiraachuu isaa fi du'aatii fi miidhaan lubbuu jiraachuu isaa hanga ammaa ifa miti. Haleellaan kun qindoomina waraana Israa'el kan kibba Libaanos keessatti geggeeffamaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Trump says Iran is ‘failing badly’ as conflict in Yemen widens
english: Former President Donald Trump recently suggested that the United States could take military action against Iran, claiming the country is suffering from severe economic instability and military weakness. This comes as tensions rise in the Middle East, specifically regarding the conflict in Yemen and ongoing attacks involving Houthi rebels. While Trump did not provide a specific timeline for potential operations, he emphasized that Iran’s current domestic struggles make them vulnerable.

oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, Iraan rakkoo dinagdee cimaa fi dadhabina waraanaatiin miidhamtee waan jirtuuf Ameerikaan tarkaanfii waraanaa irratti fudhachuu akka dandeessu dubbataniiru. Yaanni kun kan kenname yeroo waraanni Yaman hammaataa jiru fi haleellaan garee Huutii biyyoota naannichaa irratti raawwatamaa jiruutti. Tiraamp tarkaanfii kanaaf yeroo murtaa'e tokko kan hin ibsine ta'us, rakkoon keessoo Iraan biyyattii dadhabsiisuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: EU urges US to reverse proposed sanctions against ICC
english: The European Union has formally requested that the United States withdraw its planned sanctions against the International Criminal Court. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas emphasized that the court is vital for global justice and must operate without outside intimidation. The bloc reaffirmed its commitment to protecting the court’s independence and supporting its staff against these restrictive measures.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት አሜሪካ በዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ ለመጣል ያቀደችውን ማዕቀብ እንድትሰርዝ ጠይቋል። የህብረቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ኃላፊ ካጃ ካላስ ፍርድ ቤቱ ለአለም አቀፍ ፍትህ ስርዓት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ እና ያለ ምንም ውጫዊ ተጽዕኖ መስራት እንዳለበት አስረድተዋል። ህብረቱ የፍርድ ቤቱን ነጻነት ለመጠበቅ እና ሰራተኞቹን ለመደገፍ ሙሉ ቁርጠኝነት እንዳለውም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa mootummaan Ameerikaa adabbii gosa garaa garaa mana murtii yakka addunyaarratti kaasuuf karoorfatte akka dhiistu gaafateera. Itti gaafatamaan siyaasa alaa Gamtaichaa Kaajaa Kaalaas, manni murtichaa sirna haqaa idil-addunyaatiif murteessaa waan ta'eef, dhiibbaa malee hojjechuu akka qabu ibsaniiru. Gamtaan Awurooppaa bilisummaa mana murtichaa eeguufi hojjettoota isaa deggeruuf murannoo guutuu akka qabu mirkaneesseera.

title: Trump says Iran is ‘failing badly’ as conflict in Yemen widens
english: President Trump has suggested that future military actions against Iran remain possible as regional instability grows. He claims Iran is currently struggling due to economic collapse and military failures, though he provided no specific timeline for potential US involvement. Meanwhile, violence has escalated in Yemen, where recent Houthi missile strikes on Saudi infrastructure have resulted in civilian casualties.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ በመጣው አለመረጋጋት ሳቢያ በኢራን ላይ ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ሊወሰድ እንደሚችል ጠቁመዋል። የኢራን ኢኮኖሚ እና ወታደራዊ አቅም ክፉኛ መዳከሙን የገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ በአሜሪካ ሊወሰድ ስለሚችለው እርምጃ የተወሰነ ጊዜ አልሰጡም። በሌላ በኩል በየመን እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ፣ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በፈጸሙት ጥቃት የበርካታ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp sababa walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa dabalaa dhufeen, gara fuulduraatti Iran irratti tarkaanfiin waraanaa fudhatamuu akka danda'u himaniiru. Dinagdeen Iran fi humnootiin ishee waraanaa akka dadhabanii fi biyyattiin rakkoo cimaa keessa akka jirtu kan ibsan yoo ta'u, tarkaanfii Ameerikaan fudhattuuf garuu yeroo murtaa'e hin kennine. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Yemen keessatti hammaachaa adeemuun, haleellaa rokkeetii gareen Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa Saudi Arabia irratti raawwateen lubbuun namoota nagaa hedduu darbeera.

title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
english: A Mexican court has convicted three men for the 2024 murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend while the group was on a surfing trip in Baja California. Prosecutors revealed the victims were killed during a failed attempt to steal their truck, after which their bodies were hidden in a well. Although the perpetrators are awaiting their final sentences, they are expected to serve lengthy prison terms for these tragic crimes that occurred in a popular beach town.
amharic: የሜክिको ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 በባጃ ካሊፎርኒያ በሰርፊንግ ጉዞ ላይ የነበሩ ሁለት አውስትራሊያውያን ወንድማማቾችን እና አንድ አሜሪካዊ ጓደኛቸውን የገደሉ ሶስት ወንዶችን ጥፋተኛ ብሎ ወስኗል። አቃቤ ህግ እንደገለጸው ግለሰቦቹ የተገደሉት የጭነት መኪናቸውን ለመዝረፍ በተደረገ ሙከራ ወቅት ሲሆን፣ አስከሬናቸውም በጉድጓድ ውስጥ ተጥሎ ተገኝቷል። ጥፋተኛ የተባሉት ግለሰቦች የቅጣት ውሳኔ እየጠበቁ ቢሆንም፣ በታዋቂ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢ ለፈጸሙት ይህ ዘግናኝ ድርጊት የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ሊፈረድባቸው እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mana murtii Meksikootti namoonni sadan waggaa 2024 keessa obboloota Awustiraaliyaa lama fi michuu isaanii lammii Ameerikaa tokko naannoo Baja California-tti imala sarfii irratti jiranii ajjeesuu isaaniitiin yakka irratti mirkanaa'eera. Akkuma abbaan alangaa ibsetti, dargaggoonni kun kan ajjeefaman konkolaataa isaanii saamuuf yaalii godhame irratti yoo ta'u, reeffi isaaniis boolla keessa darbatamee argameera. Namoonni yakka kana raawwatan adabbii isaanii eeggachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, naannoo daawwattootaan jaallatamu kana keessatti yakka suukanneessaa kana raawwataniif hidhaa cimaa itti murtaa'a jedhamee eeggama.

title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
english: UAE authorities stated that an Omani pilot who attempted to hijack a Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv had been radicalized while studying in Australia. The pilot, who reportedly aimed to carry out a suicide crash, was subdued by passengers after attacking the captain with an axe. Investigations suggest he acted alone and was inspired by extremist ideologies and terrorist propaganda.

oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa UAE akka ibsanitti, balalii Flydubai gara Tel Aviviitti imalaa ture butuuf kan yaale ogeessi balaliisaa Omaan tokko, yeroo Awustiraaliyaa keessa barataa turetti gara hammaattummaatti gombifame. Namichi kun kapiteena xiyyaarichaa erga miidhee booda imaltootaan to’atamuu danda’eera. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, namichi kun kutaannoo fi ilaalcha cimaa warra shororkeessitootaan kaka’ee kan hojjete yoo ta’u, tarkaanficha kophaasaa kan raawwate ta’uu himameera.

title: Isaias weakens after making landfall in US Gulf Coast as hurricane
english: Hurricane Isaias made landfall on the US Gulf Coast, causing widespread power outages for over 664,000 people and significant damage to trees and infrastructure. Although it has since weakened into a post-tropical storm, it continues to pose risks of severe flooding and high winds across Florida and Alabama. Authorities are actively responding to the situation, with search-and-rescue teams deployed and emergency declarations already in effect.
amharic: አውሎ ነፋስ ኢሳይያስ የአሜሪካን የባህር ዳርቻ በመምታቱ ከ664,000 በላይ ሰዎች የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት አቋርጦባቸዋል፣ እንዲሁም በዛፎች እና መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። አውሎ ነፋሱ በአሁኑ ጊዜ ወደ ሞቃታማ የከባቢ አየር ስርዓት ተቀይሮ የደከመ ቢሆንም፣ አሁንም በፍሎሪዳ እና አላባማ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ እና የንፋስ ስጋት አለ። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ተሰማርተው የአደጋ ጊዜ እርምጃዎች እየተወሰዱ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hurricane Isaias qubannaa isaa qarqara galaana USitti godhateen, namoota 664,000 olitti humna ibsaa kan dhabsiise yoo ta'u, mukkeenii fi qabeenya irrattis miidhaa cimaa geessiseera. Gufurichi amma humni isaa hir'atee obomboleettii laafaa ta'us, naannoo Floridaa fi Alabaamaatti rooba cimaa fi dhiibbaa qilleensaa sodaachisuu itti fufeera. Mootummaan garee oobsuu fi gargaarsa namoomaa bobbaasee hojii ariifachiisaa hojjechaa jira.

title: West Indies beat India as Hope’s hundred secures record T20 chase
english: The West Indies leveled their T20 series against India after a historic successful run chase of 252 runs. Shai Hope scored an unbeaten 102, supported by Sherfane Rutherford’s 84, to overtake India's massive total of 249. This victory marks the second-highest successful chase in T20 international history.
amharic: የዌስት ኢንዲስ ብሔራዊ ቡድን ህንድን በማሸነፍ የቲ-20 ተከታታይ ጨዋታዎችን አቻ አድርገዋል። ሻይ ሆፕ ባስመዘገበው 102 ነጥብ እና በሸርፋን ራዘርፎርድ 84 ነጥብ ታግዞ ቡድኑ ህንድ ካስመዘገበችው 249 ነጥብ በመነሳት 252 በማስቆጠር ታሪካዊ ድል ተቀዳጅቷል። ይህ ውጤት በቲ-20 ዓለም አቀፍ ውድድሮች ታሪክ ሁለተኛው ከፍተኛ የተሳካ የውጤት ማሳደድ ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: gareen West Indies tapha T20 Indiyaa wajjin godhe injifannoon xumuruun wal-qixa ta’aniiru. Shai Hope fi Sherfane Rutherford qabxii olaanaa galchuun, Indiyaan qabxii 249 galchite akka injifatan gargaaraniiru. West Indies qabxii 252 galchuun, seenaa tapha T20 keessatti injifannoo qabxii guddaa hordofee argame keessaa sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti argamu.

title: A decade of Lajee Celtic: The Palestinian club whose fans include Cantona
english: Lajee Celtic is a football club formed in the Aida refugee camp in the West Bank that has turned into a global symbol of solidarity over the past ten years. The project grew from connections between the local community and Scottish football supporters, gaining fame after Celtic fans famously waved Palestinian flags during a match against an Israeli team. Today, the club is supported by international celebrities and continues to promote the values of the Palestinian people through sports.
amharic: ላጂ ሴልቲክ (Lajee Celtic) በዌስት ባንክ በአይዳ የስደተኞች ካምፕ የተመሰረተ የእግር ኳስ ክለብ ሲሆን ላለፉት አስር ዓመታት ዓለም አቀፍ የአንድነት ምልክት ሆኗል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ እና በስኮትላንድ እግር ኳስ ደጋፊዎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግንኙነት ያደገ ሲሆን፣ የሴልቲክ ደጋፊዎች ከእስራኤል ቡድን ጋር በተደረገ ጨዋታ የፍልስጤም ሰንደቅ ዓላማ በማውለብለባቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል። በአሁኑ ጊዜ ክለቡ በታዋቂ ግለሰቦች ዘንድ ድጋፍ ያለው ሲሆን በስፖርት አማካኝነት የፍልስጤምን ህዝብ እሴቶች ማስተዋወቅ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Lajee Celtic kilabii kubbaa miilaa kaampii baqattootaa Aidaa kan West Bank keessatti hundeeffame yoo ta'u, waggoota kudhan darban keessatti mallattoo tokkummaa addunyaa ta'eera. Pirojektiin kun walitti dhufeenya hawaasa naannichaa fi deggertoota kubbaa miilaa Iskotlaandii gidduutti uumameen guddachuu danda'eera. Deggertoonni Selteek tapha garee Israa'el wajjin taasisaniin alaabaa Filisxeem baasuudhaan beekamtii addunyaa argachuu danda'aniiru. Yeroo ammaa kilabichi namoota beekamoo biratti deggarsa kan qabu yoo ta'u, ispoortii fayyadamuudhaan duudhaa ummata Filisxeem beeksisuu itti fufeera.

title: US lifts sanctions on daughter of military-linked Myanmar businessman
english: The U.S. Treasury Department has removed sanctions on Theint Win Htet, the daughter of a businessman linked to Myanmar's military government, following her legal challenge. This move comes shortly after reports emerged that the Trump administration had initiated new discussions with Myanmar's leadership, marking a shift from previous policies. While Htet argued she had no involvement in her father's company, activists have criticized the decision as a setback in pressuring the military regime.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት መሥሪያ ቤት ከምያንማር ወታደራዊ መንግሥት ጋር ግንኙነት ካለው ነጋዴ ልጅ ጋር በተያያዘ የተጣለባትን ማዕቀብ አንስቷል። ውሳኔው የመጣው የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከምያንማር መንግሥት ጋር ውይይት መጀመሩ ከተሰማ በኋላ ነው። ተጎጂዋ በንግድ ድርጅቱ ውስጥ ምንም ዓይነት ተሳትፎ እንደሌላት ክስ በመመሥረት ማዕቀቡ እንዲነሳላት ማድረጓን ተከትሎ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ቢሆንም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ውሳኔውን ተችተውታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa intala daldalaa waraana biyyattii waliin hariiroo qabu kan taate Theint Win Htet irratti kan ture sanadaa (sanctions) kaasuu isaa beeksiseera. Murtiin kun kan dhufu, bulchiinsi Trump mootummaa Myanmar waliin marii haaraa jalqabuu isaa gabaasuun booda dha. Htet daldala abbaa ishee keessatti hirmaannaa akka hin qabne falmachuun ishee injifannoo argattuus, gareewwan mirga namoomaa murtee kana mormaniiru.

title: Ronaldo returns after Portugal quarrel to score in Al-Nassr win
english: Cristiano Ronaldo made a successful return to his club team, Al-Nassr, following a dispute with the Portuguese national team that led to his departure. He scored the opening goal in a 3-0 victory over Diriyah, marking the 980th goal of his career. Despite his performance, uncertainty remains regarding his future with Portugal after he criticized his national coach.
amharic: ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ ከፖርቱጋል ብሔራዊ ቡድን ጋር ከተፈጠረ አለመግባባት በኋላ ወደ ክለቡ አል-ናስር ተመልሶ ውጤታማ ጨዋታ አሳይቷል። በዲሪያህ ላይ 3-0 በሆነ ውጤት በተጠናቀቀው የሊግ ጨዋታ የመጀመሪያዋን ግብ በማስቆጠር የሙያ ግቦቹን ብዛት ወደ 980 ከፍ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን በክለቡ ጥሩ እንቅስቃሴ ቢያደርግም፣ በብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኙ ላይ ባነሳው ትችት ምክንያት ከፖርቱጋል ጋር ያለው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ እርግጠኛ አይደለም።
oromo: Cristiano Ronaldo garee biyya isaa Portugal waliin wal dhabee erga gadi lakkisee booda, deebi'ee tapha kilabii Al-Nassr irratti milkaa'ina argateera. Tapha Diriyah irratti 3-0 injifatan irratti goolii jalqabaa galchuun, galiiwwan hunda walitti qabamee 980 ga'eera. Gootummaa isaa kana keessaayyuu, lolaa leenjisaa biyya isaa waliin qabuun wal qabatee gara fuulduratti taphataa biyya lafaa kanaa waliin haalli jiru gaaffii keessa galeera.

title: Yousof Azizi: The Iranian-American scholar pressured by the FBI to return to Iran
english: Yousof Azizi, a long-term Iranian-American resident and academic, was arrested by US authorities who accused him of having secret ties to a designated Iranian paramilitary group. Despite having no criminal record, Azizi spent three months in detention after officials questioned his immigration status and failed to provide concrete evidence regarding his alleged military background. Ultimately, the scholar opted to leave the United States voluntarily rather than continue facing pressure and legal uncertainty.
amharic: ረጅም ጊዜ በአሜሪካ የኖሩት ኢራናዊው ምሁር ዩሱፍ አዚዚ፣ በኢራን ወታደራዊ ቡድን አባልነት ተጠርጥረው በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ታሰሩ። ምንም አይነት የወንጀል ታሪክ ባይኖርባቸውም፣ ባለስልጣናቱ የቀረበውን ክስ ለማረጋገጥ የሚያስችል ማስረጃ ሳያቀርቡ ለሶስት ወራት ያህል በእስር እንዲቆዩ ተደርገዋል። በመጨረሻም ምሁሩ በደረሰባቸው ጫና እና በህጋዊ ሂደቶች ምክንያት ከአሜሪካ በፈቃዳቸው ለቀው ለመውጣት ተገደዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun lammii Iraan kan yeroo dheeraaf Ameerikaa jiraachaa ture Yousof Azizi, garee waraanaa Iraan waliin hidhata qaba jedhamee mootummaa Ameerikaan to’annoo jala oole. Yakka tokkollee kan hin qabne ta’us, aangessitoonni ragaa gahaa hin dhiheessin ji'a sadiif mana hidhaa keessatti isa tursiisan. Dhumarrattis, hayyuun kun dhiibbaa irra ga'aa ture irraa kan ka'e Ameerikaa gadhiisee fedhii isaatiin gara biyya isaa deebi'uuf murteesse.

title: Senior Iranian officials hit back at Rubio after Athens speech
english: Senior Iranian officials have strongly condemned recent remarks by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who compared current US-Iran tensions to ancient conflicts between Greece and Persia. Iranian leaders criticized Rubio for attacking Iran's historical legacy while ignoring the US's own history of violence and colonial actions. They accused the US official of hypocrisy for praising Greek resistance while labeling Iranian resilience as negative, arguing that Washington’s goal is to undermine Iranian independence.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በቅርቡ በአቴንስ ያደረጉትን ንግግር በጽኑ አውግዘዋል። ሩቢዮ በንግግራቸው የጥንቱን የግሪክ እና የፋርስ ግጭት አሁን ካለው የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ውጥረት ጋር ማነጻጸራቸው የኢራን መሪዎችን አስቆጥቷል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ሩቢዮ የኢራንን ታሪክ በማጥላላት አሜሪካ በራሷ ላይ የፈጸመችውን የኃይል እርምጃ ችላ ብለዋል ሲሉ ከሰዋል። በተጨማሪም የአሜሪካው ባለስልጣን የግሪክን ተጋድሎ እያደነቁ የኢራንን ብርታት መተቸታቸው ድርብ መመዘኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni olaanoon Iraan ibsa ministirri dhimma alaa Ameerikaa Maarko Ruubiyoo magaala Ateensitti kennanitti baay'ee gadduu isaanii ibsaniiru. Ruubiyoon walitti bu'iinsa bara durii Giriikii fi Faarisii gidduutti turee fi walitti bu'iinsa yeroo ammaa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru walbira qabuun isaanii hoggantoota Iraan mufachiiseera. Hoggantoonni Iraan, Ruubiyoon seenaa Iraan xureessuun gocha Ameerikaa irra ture dhoksuu isaanii balaaleffataniiru. Akkasumas, Ruubiyoon jabaachuu Giriikii faarsanii kan Iraan garuu balaaleffachuun isaanii of-fudhannoo dhabuu fi dhiibbaa gochuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Israel launches more strikes in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted airstrikes on Saturday between the Lebanese towns of Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Kfar Tebnit. As of now, there is no official information regarding potential injuries or destruction caused by the attacks. The situation remains under observation as authorities have yet to confirm the full impact of the strikes.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች ቅዳሜ ዕለት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ ናባቲህ አል-ፈውቃ እና ካፋር ተብኒት ከተሞች መካከል የአየር ድብደባ ፈጽመዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ በጥቃቱ የደረሰ ጉዳት ወይም የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ስለመኖሩ የተገለጸ ነገር የለም። ባለስልጣናት ስለ ጥቃቱ ዝርዝር ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarotni waraana Israa'el guyyaa Dilbataatti kibba Libaanoos, magaaloota Nabatiyeh al-Fawqa fi Kfar Tebnit gidduutti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan qaqqabe ykn lubbuun darbe hanga ammaatti beekkamuu baatus, qorannoon itti fufee jira. Hanga ammaatti oduun miidhaa qaamaa ykn qabeenyaa irratti ga'e hin ibsamne.

title: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
english: President Trump has made a surprising deal to import Russian diesel fuel to the U.S. in an attempt to lower rising energy costs before the midterm elections. This move marks a major shift in policy, as he recently supported sanctions against Russian energy imports. The decision has drawn criticism for potentially funding Russia's war efforts, especially as the president struggles with the political consequences of high inflation and fuel prices.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫው ዋዜማ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ በማሰብ ከሩሲያ ጋር ያልተጠበቀ የነዳጅ ማስገባት ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በቅርቡ በሩሲያ ላይ ማዕቀብ ከጣሉበት የቀድሞ አቋማቸው ጋር የሚቃረን ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የሩሲያን የጦር መሣሪያ ኢንዱስትሪ ይረዳል በሚል ስምምነቱ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ሲሆን፣ የዋጋ ግሽበት በፖለቲካው ላይ የፈጠረውን ጫና ለመቋቋም የተወሰደ መፍትሄ ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Tiraamp filannoo giddu-galeessa biyyattii dura gatii boba'aa hir'isuuf jechuudhaan biyyattii keessatti gurguramuuf Raashiyaa irraa boba'aa diizelii bituuf walii galtee raajiin ta'e tokko mallatteessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kanaan dura Raashiyaa irratti ergaa turan waliin kan wal faallessuu fi mormii guddaa kan hordofsiiseedha. Murtii kana kan fudhatan gatii boba'aa ol ka'eefii haala diinagdee biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa uumame sirreessuuf yoo ta'u, kunis Raashiyaaf deggersa maallaqaa kenna jechuun komatamaa jira.

title: Thousands of security personnel deployed as Delhi braces for ‘cockroach’ protest
english: Authorities in Delhi have deployed over 30,000 security personnel and blocked major access routes to prevent a large-scale demonstration organized by the youth-led Cockroach movement. The protesters are demanding electoral reforms and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner due to accusations of voter list manipulation. Despite official bans and public transport shutdowns, organizers remain committed to holding the protest at Jantar Mantar.
amharic: የዴልሂ ባለሥልጣናት በወጣቶች የሚመራው 'ኮክሮች' የተሰኘው ንቅናቄ ሊያካሂድ ያቀደውን ትልቅ ሰልፍ ለመከላከል ከ30,000 በላይ የጸጥታ ኃይሎችን በማሰማራት ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን ዘግተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምርጫ ዝርዝር በማጭበርበር ክስ የዋና ምርጫ ኮሚሽነሩ እንዲለቁ እና የምርጫ ማሻሻያ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው። መንግስት ሰልፉን ቢከለክልም እና የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶችን ቢያስተጓጉልም፣ አዘጋጆቹ በታቀደው ቦታ ተቃውሟቸውን ለመግለጽ ቆርጠው ተነስተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan bulchiinsa Deelhi, sochii dargaggootaa 'Cockroach' jedhamuun qophaa'e ittisuuf humnoota nageenyaa 30,000 ol bobbaasee karaawwan gurguddoos cufuu isaa gabaafameera. Hiriirtonni kun sirreeffama filannoo fi komishinarri filannoo olaanaa himannaa sochii maqaa balleessii irratti dhiyaateef akka gadhiisan gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan hiriiricha kan dhorke yoo ta'us, qindeessitoonni hiriiricha bakka itti yaadame sanatti geggeessuuf murteessanii jiru.

title: Life-threatening Hurricane Isaias makes landfall in Florida
english: Hurricane Isaias has struck the Florida coast as a Category 2 storm, bringing dangerous winds and a high risk of severe flooding. Authorities in Florida, Alabama, and Georgia have declared states of emergency and ordered mandatory evacuations for vulnerable coastal areas. The storm is expected to continue inland toward the Tennessee Valley, with weather experts warning residents to remain alert for storm surges and potential tornadoes.
amharic: አውሎ ንፋስ ኢሳይያስ በምድብ ሁለት ጥንካሬ የፍሎሪዳን የባህር ዳርቻ በመምታቱ ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ እና አውዳሚ ነፋሶችን አስከትሏል። የፍሎሪዳ፣ የአላባማ እና የጆርጂያ ግዛቶች የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አዘዋል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ወደ ውስጠኛው ክፍል እንደሚጓዝ የተጠበቀ ሲሆን፣ ባለሙያዎች ነዋሪዎች ከጎርፍ እና ሊከሰቱ ከሚችሉ አውሎ ነፋሶች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hurricane Isaias humna sadarkaa lammaffaan qabuun qarqara galaana Florida rukutee, bubbee cimaafi balaa lolaa sodaachisaa fiduu irra jira. Bulchiistonni Florida, Alabama fi Georgia labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsuun namootni naannoo balaaf saaxilamoo ta'an irraa akka godaanan ajajaniiru. Bubbeen kun gara kutaa biyyaa keessatti itti fufa jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, ogeeyyiin qilleensaa jiraattonni balaa lolaa fi bubbee qilleensaa (tornado) irraa of eegu akka qaban akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Putin tells Trump peace talks are unlikely, cites Ukraine drone attacks
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin informed US President Donald Trump that peace negotiations with Ukraine are currently stalled due to recent Ukrainian drone strikes on Moscow during parliamentary elections. While Ukraine had expressed readiness for trilateral talks, the Kremlin stated that these attacks have made an immediate restart of discussions unlikely. Meanwhile, a controversial new agreement for Russia to supply diesel to the US market has drawn strong criticism from Ukraine and Western allies, who argue it provides financial support for Russia's ongoing military efforts.
amharic: የሩሲያ ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ለአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እንደገለጹት፣ በምርጫ ወቅት በሞስኮ ላይ የተፈጸሙ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ ከዩክሬን ጋር የሚደረጉ የሰላም ንግግሮች አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ መቀጠል እንደማይችሉ አስታውቀዋል። ዩክሬን ድርድር ለመጀመር ፍላጎት ብታሳይም፣ የክሬምሊን ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቶቹ የንግግር ሂደቱን እንዳስተጓጎሉት ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሩሲያ ለአሜሪካ የናፍጣ ነዳጅ ለማቅረብ የተስማማችው ስምምነት፣ የዩክሬንን እና የምዕራባውያን አጋሮችን ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለሩሲያ የጦርነት ጥረት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚሆን ተችቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vlaadimiir Puutin pireezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Traampitti akka himanitti, yeroo filannoo biyyoolessaatti Moskoo irratti haleellaan droonii raawwatamuu isaa hordofee mariin nagaa Yukreen waliin ta'uuf ture dhaabachuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Yukreen marii kanarratti hirmaachuuf fedhii kan qabdu ta'us, mootummaan Raashiyaa haleellaan kun carraa marii kanaa akka gufachiise ibseera. Gama biraatiin, Raashiyaan gabaa Ameerikaaf diizeelii gurguruuf waliigaltee gochuun ishee, Yukreeniifi michoota lixaa biratti mormii guddaa kan kaase yoo ta'u, kunis waraana Raashiyaan gaggeessituuf gargaarsa maallaqaa ta'uu isaa akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Two Renoir paintings recovered after France museum heist, mayor says
english: Two valuable paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir that were stolen from a museum in southern France last month have been successfully recovered. Authorities have arrested six individuals suspected of being involved in the organized heist at the Cagnes-sur-Mer museum. While the paintings are now safe, the mayor emphasized the need for better security to protect cultural heritage sites.
amharic: ባለፈው ወር በደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይ በሚገኝ ሙዚየም ተዘርፈው የነበሩ ሁለት ውድ የፒየር-ኦገስት ሬኖየር ስዕሎች ተገኝተዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ በካኝ-ሱር-ሜር ሙዚየም በተፈጸመው በዚህ ዘረፋ ተሳትፈዋል የተባሉ ስድስት ግለሰቦችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ስዕሎቹ መገኘታቸው እፎይታ የፈጠረ ቢሆንም፣ የከተማው ከንቲባ የባህል ቅርስ ቦታዎችን ለመጠበቅ የተሻለ የደህንነት ስርዓት እንደሚያስፈልግ አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Ji'a darbe keessa bakka kuusaa sanaa (museum) Faransaay kibbaa keessatti hatamanii turan suuraawwan Pierre-Auguste Renoir lamaan deebi'anii argamaniiru. Humni poolisii namoota ja'a seeraan ala hatuu kana raawwatan jedhaman to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Suuraawwan kun deebi'anii argamuun isaanii gammachuu uumuyyuu, kantiibaan magaalaa sanaa bakkeewwan aadaa eeguufi kunuunsuuf nageenyi caalaatti cimuu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Dual quakes devastate southern Panama
english: A pair of powerful earthquakes recently struck the Herrera province in southern Panama, causing significant destruction to local buildings. Following the magnitude 7.5 and 6.6 tremors, the country’s leader officially declared a major disaster due to widespread power outages and infrastructure damage. Emergency efforts are currently underway as the region continues to experience numerous aftershocks.
amharic: ሁለት ተከታታይ ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች በፓናማ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በሚገኘው የሄሬራ ግዛት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። መጠናቸው 7.5 እና 6.6 የሆኑት እነዚህ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች ቤቶችን በማፍረሳቸው እና የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦትን በማስተጓጎላቸው የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት የአደጋ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጀዋል። አካባቢው አሁንም በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰቱ ንዑስ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች እየደረሱበት በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Socho'aan lafaa cimaan lama magaalaa Herrera kan kibba Panamaatti argamutti mudate waan jiruuf miidhaan guddaan geessiseera. Socho'aan lafaa kun sadarkaa 7.5 fi 6.6 kan qabu yoo ta'u, manneen diigee fi ibsaan akka citu taasiseera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, pireezidaantiin biyyattii hatattamaa ta'ee fi guddaa ta'e kana labsuun, amma hojiin gargaarsaa fi tasgabbeessuu itti fufee jira.
