title: Intercommunal clashes kill 71 people in South Sudan
english: Violent intercommunal clashes in the town of Rumbek, South Sudan, have resulted in the deaths of approximately 71 people, including four soldiers. Armed outsiders temporarily seized control of the area before government security forces intervened to restore order. The government is now working to stabilize the situation and has called for calm to prevent further retaliatory violence during this transitional political period.
amharic: በደቡብ ሱዳን ሩምቤክ ከተማ በተከሰተ ግጭት ቢያንስ 71 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን የመንግሥት መግለጫ አመልክቷል። ከከተማው ውጭ የመጡ ታጣቂዎች አካባቢውን ለጊዜው ቢቆጣጠሩም፣ የመንግሥት የፀጥታ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ በመግባት ሁኔታውን መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። መንግሥት ግጭቱ እንዲቆም ጥሪ ያቀረበ ሲሆን፣ በቀጣይ የሰላም እና የመረጋጋት ስራዎችን ለማከናወን ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Sudaan Kibbaatti magaalaa Rumbekitti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen lubbuun namoota 71 ol darbuun ibsameera. Gareen hidhattootaa alaa dhufan magaalattii to'achuuf yaalanii turanillee, humnoonni nageenyaa mootummaa battalatti seenuun to'annoo isaanii jala oolchaniiru. Mootummaan gocha kanaan gadduu isaa ibsuun, waldhabdeen kun akka hin hammaanneef hawaasni tasgabbii akka eegu gaafateera.

title: Trump calls Navi Pillay 'mystery person', laments Nobel snub
english: Donald Trump criticized the Nobel Committee after they awarded the Peace Prize to former judge Navi Pillay, whom he dismissed as an unknown figure. Trump expressed his frustration over being overlooked for the award, labeling the decision as embarrassing and accusing the committee of being biased. He further claimed credit for preventing various international conflicts to argue that he was more deserving of the honor.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኖቤል ሰላም ሽልማትን ለቀድሞዋ ዳኛ ናቪ ፒላይ መስጠታቸውን ተከትሎ ኮሚቴውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተችተዋል። ትራምፕ ሽልማቱን አለማግኘታቸው ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ ውሳኔውን አሳፋሪ ሲሉ ኮንነዋል። በምትኩ፣ በበርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ ግጭቶች መፍትሄ ላይ ሚና እንደነበራቸው በመጥቀስ ሽልማቱ ለሳቸው ይገባ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Doonaald Traamp badhaasa nageenyaa Nobel kan durii abbaa seeraa Navii Pilaayif kenname ilaalchisee komitee Nobel komateera. Traamp badhaasa kana ofiin dhabuun isaa akka isa aarse ibsuun, murteen kun kan nama qaanessuufi komiteenis miila tokko kan laatu ta'uu dubbate. Innis walitti buiinsa addunyaa gara garaa tasgabbeessuuf gumaacha gochuusaa kaasuun, badhaasichi kan isaaf malu ta'uu ibse.

title: Israeli military raids village in Syria's Quneitra province
english: The Israeli military recently conducted search operations and raids within Rasm al-Haydarah, a village located in Syria's Quneitra province. Additionally, Israeli forces launched artillery strikes targeting agricultural lands near the villages of al-Samdaniya al-Sharqiya, Buraiqa, and Kodana. These actions are part of a series of recurring military incursions and shelling incidents reported in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሶሪያ ኩኒትራ ግዛት በሚገኘው ራስ አል-ሃይዳራ መንደር ውስጥ ወረራ እና ፍተሻ አካሂዷል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ የእስራኤል ጦር በአል-ሳምዳኒያ አል-ሻርቂያ፣ ቡራይቃ እና ኮዳና መንደሮች አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ የግብርና መሬቶች ላይ የመድፍ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በክልሉ በተደጋጋሚ ከሚፈጸሙ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች እና ወረራዎች መካከል የሚካተቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Warri Israa'el ganda Rasm al-Haydarah kan naannoo Quneitra, Siiriyaa keessatti argamu irratti duulaafi qorannoo geggeessanii jiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el naannoo ganda al-Samdaniya al-Sharqiya, Buraiqaafi Kodanaatti lafa qonnaa irratti dhukaasa madafaa bananii jiru. Gochoota kunneenis naannichatti duulawwaniifi dhukaasa irra deddeebi'amee raawwatamu keessatti kan hammatamanidha.

title: Yemeni government says 1,400 Houthis killed in 2,750 strikes
english: The Yemeni government reported that over 1,400 Houthi fighters were killed during a massive 24-hour military campaign involving more than 2,750 targeted strikes. These operations are part of a new offensive called 'Dawn of Yemen' aimed at reclaiming territories currently under Houthi control. Military officials confirmed that the attacks successfully hit significant targets located deep within enemy-held areas.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከ1,400 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቋል። ይህ ዘመቻ 'የየመን ንጋት' በሚል ስያሜ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተቆጣጠሯቸውን ቦታዎች መልሶ ለመያዝ የታለመ ነው። የጦር ኃይሉ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ ጥቃቶቹ በጠላት ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ አካባቢዎች የሚገኙ ዋና ዋና ወታደራዊ መሠረቶችን ኢላማ ያደረጉ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeeffameen loltoonni Huutii 1,400 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru. Duulli 'Barii Yemen' jedhamu kun lafa humnoonni Huutii to'atanii jiran deebisanii qabachuuf kan karoorfame dha. Dubbi himaan waraanaa akka ibsanitti, rukutaan kun qabeenya waraanaa barbaachisaa ta'e kanneen naannoo diinonni to'atanii jiran keessa jiran kan caccabse dha.

title: Palestinian man killed by Israeli forces in West Bank, health ministry says
english: A 32-year-old Palestinian man named Shadi Ahmad Ibrahim Ajarma was shot and killed by Israeli military personnel near Hebron in the West Bank. The Palestinian Ministry of Health confirmed the incident took place late Friday. Authorities report that the Israeli military is currently keeping the deceased's body.
amharic: ሻዲ አህመድ ኢብራሂም አጃርማ የተባሉ የ32 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ በዌስት ባንክ ሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ተገድለዋል። የፍልስጤም ጤና ሚኒስቴር የግድያውን መፈጸም ያረጋገጠ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች የተጎጂውን አስከሬን እንደያዙ መገለጹ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 32 ta'e Shadi Ahmad Ibraahiim Ajaarmaa jedhamu, naannoo Heebroon kan argamu Qilleensa Bahaa (West Bank) keessatti waraana Israa'eliin ajjeefameera. Ministeerri Fayyaa Falasxiin ergaa dabarseen lubbuun nama kanaa darbuusaa mirkaneessee jira. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, qaamni nama ajjeefamee kun harka waraana Israa'elitti akka jiru beekameera.

title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
english: A major 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck near Pitaloza Arriba, Panama, on Friday, causing significant structural damage to buildings in several towns. While millions experienced severe shaking and residents evacuated many structures, there have been no reports of casualties so far. Authorities are monitoring the situation as aftershocks continue, and initial tsunami warnings for the region have been lifted.
amharic: አርብ ዕለት በፓናማ ፒታሎዛ አሪባ አቅራቢያ የ7.7 ማግኒቲዩድ መጠን ያለው ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቶ በበርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የንዝረቱን ኃይል የተሰማቸው ሲሆን ነዋሪዎችም ህንጻዎችን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተደርገዋል፣ እስካሁን ድረስ በሰው ሕይወት ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት አልተዘገበም። የድህረ-መንቀጥቀጥ ንዝረቶች ስለሚቀጥሉ ባለስልጣናት ሁኔታውን እየተከታተሉ ሲሆን ለክልሉ የተሰጠው የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያም ተነስቷል።
oromo: Jimaata darbe biyya Panama, magaalaa Pitaloza Arriba keessatti sochiin lafaa humni isaa 7.7 ta'e cimaan mudatee miidhaa qabeenyaa geessiseera. Namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman sochiin lafaa kun itti dhaga'amee ijaarsota gara garaa keessaa baqachuu kan danda'an yoo ta'u, ammaaf namoota du'an ykn mada'an irratti gabaasni hin jiru. Sochii lafaa kana hordofee miidhaan biraa akka hin mudanne mootummaan hordofaa jiru yoo ta'u, akeekkachiisni suunaamii dursee kenname ture hafee jira.

title: Trump confirms Fort Hood shooter’s execution will be by firing squad
english: Donald Trump has stated that Nidal Malik Hasan, who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood army base in 2009, will be executed by a firing squad. While the Pentagon reported that the event would be publicly livestreamed, the White House has not yet officially verified these details. Hasan was an army psychiatrist responsible for the mass shooting that also left dozens of others injured.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2009 በፎርት ሁድ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ 13 ሰዎችን የገደለውን ናዳል ማሊክ ሃሳንን በጥይት እንዲገደል መወሰናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የፔንታጎን ይህ የቅጣት አፈጻጸም በይፋ በኢንተርኔት በቀጥታ እንደሚተላለፍ የገለጸ ቢሆንም፣ የኋይት ሃውስ ይህንን መረጃ እስካሁን በይፋ አላረጋገጠም። የጦር ሰራዊት የሥነ-አእምሮ ባለሙያ የነበረው ሃሳን፣ በወቅቱ በፈጸመው ጥቃት ከ30 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሱ ይታወሳል።
oromo: Donald Trump namicha bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Fort Hood keessatti namoota 13 ajjeese, Nidal Malik Hasan, dhukaasa qawween akka ajjeefamu mirkaneessaniiru. Pentagooniin tarkaanfiin ajjeechaa kun ifatti viidiyoon akka darbu ibsus, mana maree mootummaa (White House) irraa garuu mirkaneessi hin kennamne. Hasan ogeessa fayyaa sammuu waraanaa kan ture yoo ta'u, haleellaa sanaan namoota 30 ol irra miidhaan ga'eera.

title: US judge rules Trump administration’s use of voter data unlawful
english: A federal judge has declared that the Trump administration acted illegally by attempting to cross-check state voter lists against a federal immigration database to identify ineligible voters. The court determined that the government lacked the authority to oversee election eligibility, a power reserved for the states. This ruling highlights significant concerns that inaccurate data could lead to the wrongful removal of lawful citizens from voter rolls.
amharic: አንድ የፌደራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የመራጮችን ዝርዝር ከፌደራል የኢሚግሬሽን መረጃ ጋር በማነፃፀር ብቁ ያልሆኑ መራጮችን ለመለየት የወሰደው እርምጃ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን ወስነዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የመራጮች ብቁነትን የመወሰን ስልጣን የፌደራል መንግስቱ ሳይሆን የየግዛቶቹ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ትክክለኛ ያልሆነ መረጃ ህጋዊ መራጮችን ከመራጮች ዝርዝር ውስጥ በስህተት ሊያስወግድ እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federalaa tokko, bulchiinsi Trump tarree maqaa filattootaa sanadalee godaantotaa wajjin wal-birq qabuun filattoota seeraan alaa adda baasuuf yaalii gochuun isaa seeraan alaa ta'uu murteesse. Mana murtichaa akka ibsetti, mirga filattootaa mirkaneessuu kan danda'an mootummoota naannolee malee mootummaan federalaa miti. Murtiin kun, odeeffannoon sirrii hin taane lammiileen seera qabeeyyii ta'an dogoggoraan tarree maqaa filattootaa keessaa akka haquu danda'u yaaddoo cimaa uumeera.

title: Manchester United vs Tottenham: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
english: Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur are set to face off at Old Trafford this Saturday in a crucial Premier League match. Both teams are currently struggling for form, and the outcome could significantly impact the job security of their managers. With Tottenham sitting at the bottom of the table and United also performing poorly, this game is widely viewed as a pivotal moment for both clubs early in the season.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ እና ቶተንሃም ሆትስፐር ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኦልድ ትራፎርድ በሚያደርጉት ወሳኝ የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ይገናኛሉ። ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በአሁኑ ወቅት ጥሩ አቋም ላይ ባለመሆናቸው፣ የዚህ ጨዋታ ውጤት የአሰልጣኞቻቸውን የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ሊወስን ይችላል። ቶተንሃም በሊጉ ደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ ግርጌ ላይ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድም አጥጋቢ ያልሆነ ውጤት በማስመዝገቡ ይህ ጨዋታ ለሁለቱም ክለቦች የውድድር ዘመኑ ወሳኝ መድረክ ሆኗል።
oromo: Manchester United fi Tottenham Hotspur guyyaa Sanbataa Old Trafford irratti tapha Premier League barbaachisaa ta'e tokko irratti wal morkatu. Gareen lamaanuu amma ammaatti gadi bu'aa waan jiraniif, bu'aan taphichaa aangoo leenjistoota isaanii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaachuu danda'a. Tottenham gabateewwan taphatootaa keessatti sadarkaa dhumaa irratti argama, Manchester United immoo qabxii gahaa waan hin arganneef, taphi kun boqonnaa murteessaa garee lamaanuuf ta'a.

title: Americans paying the price for Trump's 'disastrous war', top Democrat says
english: Representative Gregory Meeks has criticized Donald Trump for his decision to import diesel from Russia, arguing that this contradicts previous efforts to sanction Russian energy. Meeks claims that Trump's aggressive stance toward Iran has caused fuel costs to rise, placing a heavy financial burden on American citizens. He further accused the administration of prioritizing appeasement of Vladimir Putin over applying necessary economic pressure regarding the invasion of Ukraine.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የውጭ ጉዳይ ኮሚቴ አባል ግሬጎሪ ሚክስ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሩሲያ ናፍጣ ለመግዛት የገቡትን ውሳኔ አጥብቀው ተችተዋል። ሚክስ እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል በሩሲያ የኢነርጂ ዘርፍ ላይ ከተጣለው ማዕቀብ ጋር የሚጋጭ ነው። በተጨማሪም በትራምፕ ኢራን ላይ ያነጣጠረ ፖሊሲ ምክንያት የነዳጅ ዋጋ በመናሩ አሜሪካውያን ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ውስጥ መውደቃቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: miseensi koree dhimma alaa mana maree bakka buutotaa Ameerikaa Gregori Miiks, tarkaanfiin Doonaald Traamp Raashiyaa irraa diisilii bituuf fudhatan kan mormamu fi sanada duraan Raashiyaa irratti kaa'ame waliin kan wal faallessuudha jedhan. Miiks akka jedhanitti, siyaasni Traamp Iran irratti hordofaa jiran gatii boba'aa akka dabalu godhee, kunis ummata Ameerikaa irratti ba'aa dinagdee uumeera. Akkasumas, Traamp weerara Yukreeniif jecha Putin irratti dhiibbaa dinagdee uumuun irra turee, haala kana fayyadamuudhaan Putin gammachiisaa jiru jechuun himatan.

title: Pezeshkian says regional diplomacy 'shouldn't just be about holding meetings'
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that regional diplomacy must go beyond mere formalities and meetings. He stated that diplomatic efforts should serve as effective instruments for resolving crises and preventing tensions from rising. Ultimately, he called for these interactions to foster genuine collaboration and ongoing communication between neighboring countries.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዘሽኪያን ቀጠናዊ ዲፕሎማሲ ከስብሰባዎች ባለፈ ተግባራዊ ሊሆን እንደሚገባ ገለጹ። ዲፕሎማሲ ቀውሶችን ለመቆጣጠር፣ ውጥረትን ለመቀነስ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሀገራት መካከል ትርጉም ያለው ትብብር ለመፍጠር እንደ መሳሪያ መጠቀም እንዳለበት አስረድተዋል። ዋናው ግቡ ግጭቶችን መከላከል እና ቀጣይነት ያለው ውይይትን ማረጋገጥ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Preezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan, diippilomaasii naannichaa walga'iiwwan qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Diippilomaasiin kun rakkoolee furuuf, waldhabdee hir'isuuf fi biyyoota gidduutti walta'iinsa dhugaa uumuuf meeshaa barbaachisaa ta'uu akka qabu dubbataniiru. Akka isaanii, kaayyoon diippilomaasii kun marii cimaa fi waldhabdee ittisuu irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu qaba.

title: Turkey, Qatar, Kuwait condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
english: Turkey, Qatar, and Kuwait have officially condemned the recent Houthi drone strikes targeting Saudi Arabian airports. These attacks resulted in the deaths of three Saudi citizens and caused significant damage to civilian infrastructure. The three nations demanded an immediate end to the violence, describing the assaults as threats to regional security and Saudi sovereignty.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ኳታር እና ኩዌት በሳዑዲ አረቢያ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ጥቃቱ የሶስት ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ዜጎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይም ጉዳት አድርሷል። አገራቱ ይህንን ድርጊት የክልሉን ሰላም እና የሳዑዲን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጋፋ በመሆኑ ጥቃቱ በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Qatar fi Kuweyt haleellaa garee Huutii buufataalee xiyyaaraa Saudii Arabaa irratti raawwatame balaaleffataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan lammiileen Saudii sadii du'anii qabeenyis miidhameera. Biyyoonni kunneen haleellaan kun nageenya naannichaa fi abbaa biyyummaa Saudii kan tuqu waan ta'eef, hatattamaan dhaabbachuu akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: How the Red Sea came to the brink of a new regional war
english: Ethiopia and Eritrea are moving toward a potential war, fueled by Ethiopia's internal ethnic conflicts and historical rivalries between the two nations. President Abiy Ahmed is attempting to centralize power while facing resistance from groups like the TPLF, leading to military escalations. International analysts warn that this instability, combined with foreign interference, risks triggering a broader regional crisis across the Red Sea.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ እና ኤርትራ በውስጣዊ የጎሳ ግጭቶች እና በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ባለው የቆየ ታሪካዊ መቃቃር ምክንያት ወደ ጦርነት አፋፍ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አቢይ አህመድ ስልጣንን ለማማከል በሚያደርጉት ጥረት እና የህወሓት መሰል ቡድኖች በሚያሳዩት ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ወታደራዊ ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ ነው። ዓለም አቀፍ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት፣ ይህ አለመረጋጋት ከውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ጋር ተዳምሮ በቀይ ባህር አካባቢ ሰፊ ቀውስ የመፍጠር አቅም አለው።
oromo: Itoophiyaa fi Eertiraan walitti bu'iinsa gosaa keessoo fi wal dhabdee seena qabeessa gidduu isaanii jiruun wal qabatee gara waraanaatti dhihaachaa jiru. Ministirri Muummee Abiy Ahmed aangoo giddu galeessa gochuuf yaalii gochaa jiran irratti gareewwan akka ABO fi ABUT irraa mormiin guddaan mudachaa jira. Ogeeyyonni gurguddoon akka akeekkachiisanitti, rakkoon kun kanneen alaa keessa seenuun dabalamee naannoo Galaana Diimaa hundaaf balaa hamtuu fiduu danda'a.

title: Saudi-led coalition launches wide-ranging operation against Houthis
english: A Saudi-led coalition has initiated a broad military campaign against Houthi forces in Yemen. During this operation, they successfully struck over 130 military targets held by the group. Additionally, the coalition is actively providing continuous aerial assistance to support the Yemeni government's ongoing efforts.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የምትመራው ጥምረት በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ጥምረቱ በቡድኑ ቁጥጥር ስር የነበሩ ከ130 በላይ ወታደራዊ ኢላማዎችን ማውደሙን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ጥምረቱ በየመን መንግስት ኃይሎች ላይ እየተደረገ ላለው ውጊያ ተከታታይ የሆነ የአየር ድጋፍ እየሰጠ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummoota Sa'udii Arabaatiin durfamuun, waraanni Yaman keessatti argamu hidhattoota Huthota irratti duula bal'aa banuu isaa beeksiseera. Duula kanaanis, iddoowwan harka Huthotaa turan keessaa bakkeewwan waraanaa 130 ol ta'an barbadeessuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, gamtichi kun humnoota mootummaa Yaman gargaaruuf gorsa qilleensaa yeroo hundaa taasisaa jira.

title: Trump announces deal with Putin to release Russian diesel
english: President Donald Trump has secured an agreement with Vladimir Putin to increase the supply of Russian diesel to the global market to help lower rising fuel costs. Under this deal, Russia will provide several shipments of diesel starting immediately, which the US Treasury has authorized through a temporary license. This initiative is part of the administration's broader strategy to reduce energy prices for Americans ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ ከሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር የሩሲያ ዲዝል ወደ ገበያ እንዲገባ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት ሩሲያ በደረጃ የሚለቀቅ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ዲዝል ታቀርባለች፤ የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤትም ይህንን ነዳጅ ለመግባት የሚያስችል ጊዜያዊ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ይህ እርምጃ ከመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ በፊት በአሜሪካ የሚስተዋለውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ግሽበት ለመቆጣጠር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Doonaald Traamp dhiheessii diizilaa idil-addunyaatti dabaluun gatii boba'aa hir'isuuf Pirezedaantii Raashiyaa Vilaadimiir Puutin waliin walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Walii galtee kanaan, Raashiyaan diizilaa baay'ina isaa guddaa ta'e gabaatti gadhiisuuf kan itti gaafatamtu yoo ta'u, mootummaan Ameerikaas diizilli kun gabaa isaanii keessa akka seenuuf hayyama yeroo kenneera. Tarkaanfiin kun filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuun dura gatii boba'aa Ameerikaa keessatti ol ka'e hir'isuuf kan yaadame dha.

title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
english: The US administration has announced new, broad sanctions against the International Criminal Court, aiming to restrict its financial operations and protect American sovereignty. While the US claims the court acts like a rogue institution by targeting its citizens, the ICC and several world leaders have condemned the move as an attack on international justice. Despite the sanctions, many nations have reaffirmed their commitment to the court, and a temporary grace period has been granted to allow for potential negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአሜሪካን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር በሚል የዓለም አቀፉን የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) በገንዘብ ነክ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ እገዳ ጥሏል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ ውሳኔ በዓለም አቀፍ የሕግ የበላይነት ላይ የተቃጣ ጥቃት ነው ሲል ሲተች፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና ሌሎች አጋር ሀገራት በውሳኔው ቅር መሰኘታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም አሜሪካ በድርጅቱ ላይ ያሳለፈችው ማዕቀብ ውጤታማ እንዳይሆን የተወሰነ ጊዜ የሰጠች ቢሆንም፣ ይህ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ የፍትህ ስርዓቱን በእጅጉ እንደሚጎዳ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa seeraa fi mirga biyyattii kabachiisuuf jechuun, mana murtii yakkaa addunyaa (ICC) irratti tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa fudhateera. Mana murtichi tarkaanfii kana seera addunyaa irratti haleellaa kan raawwate jechuun balaaleffateera; biyyoonni addunyaa hedduunis murticha akka hin degarre ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa yeroo murtaa’e tokko kennus, tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbaticha hojii isaa akka dhaabu gochuuf kan karoorfame ta’uu beekameera.

title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
english: Former UN human rights commissioner and South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The committee honored her long-standing dedication to international law and her efforts to prosecute war crimes, genocide, and crimes against humanity. By winning this prestigious award, she joins other notable South African recipients such as Nelson Mandela and Desmond Tutu.
amharic: የቀድሞው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብት ኮሚሽነር እና የደቡብ አፍሪካዊቷ ዳኛ ናቪ ፒላይ የ2026 የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማት አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። የኖቤል ኮሚቴው ለሽልማት ያበቃቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን ለማስከበር እና የጦር ወንጀሎችን፣ የዘር ማጥፋትን እና የሰው ልጆች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ ለብዙ ዓመታት ላደረጉት ጥረት ነው። በዚህም ፒላይ እንደ ኔልሰን ማንዴላ እና ዴዝሞንድ ቱቱ ካሉ ታዋቂ የደቡብ አፍሪካ አሸናፊዎች ተርታ ተሰልፈዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun duraanii mirga namoomaa UN fi abbaan seeraa biyyaa Afrikaa Kibbaa Navi Pillay badhaasa Nobel Peace Prize kan bara 2026 injifataniiru. Komiteen Nobel kun badhaasa kana kan kenneef, seera idil-addunyaa kabajchiisuu fi yakka waraanaa, yakka sanyii balleessuu fi yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatamu qorachuuf hojii cimaa hojjechaa turaniifidha. Badhaasa kana argachuun isaanii, akkuma Nelson Mandela fi Desmond Tutu, namoota Afrikaa Kibbaa badhaasa kana argatan keessaa akka tokko isaan taasiseera.

title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
english: US Vice-President JD Vance has expressed skepticism regarding the Pentagon’s proposal to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the soldier convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. While Vance acknowledged the severity of the crimes, he stated that he would not watch the broadcast if it takes place. The plan to livestream the military execution has faced significant backlash from politicians on both sides, who argue that turning such events into public spectacles is unethical and inappropriate.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በፎርት ሁድ የጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ ፈጻሚ በሆነው ኒዳል ሀሰን ላይ ሊወሰድ የታቀደውን የመተኮስ የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማሳየት የተወሰነውን ውሳኔ ተጠራጠሩ። ምንም እንኳን የጥቃቱን አሳሳቢነት ቢገልጹም፣ ስርጭቱ ቢፈጸም እንኳን እንደማይመለከቱት አስታውቀዋል። ይህንን የሞት ቅጣት በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማስተላለፍ የታቀደው እቅድ ከሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ አባላት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ ለህዝብ መዝናኛነት መቅረቡ ስነ-ምግባር የጎደለው እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Itti aanaan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, mootummaan naannoo waraanaa Nidal Hasan jedhamu kan bara 2009 Fort Hooditti namoota ajjeese irratti murteeffamee ture, dhukaasaan ajjeesuu fi sana immoo tamsaasa kallattiin (livestream) darbusuu isaatti shakkii qaban ibsan. Vance yakkichi cimaa ta'uu isaa hubatanii, tamsaasi sun yoo ta'e illee ofii isaanii akka hin ilaalle dubbataniiru. Sagantaan ajjechaa kana tamsaasuuf karoorfame kun mormii cimaa paartilee siyaasaa lamaan biraayyuu kan itti dhufe yoo ta'u, ajjechaan akkasii akka bashannanaatti tamsaasuun safuu fi seeraan kan hin deeggaramne ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
english: The prominent Russian tech firm Yandex is experiencing major operational issues following Ukrainian drone strikes on two of its key data centers. These facilities, which are essential for the company's search engine, AI, and smart home services, sustained significant damage during the back-to-back attacks. Ukrainian officials stated the strikes were a retaliatory measure intended to disrupt resources supporting Russia's ongoing military campaign.
amharic: የሩሲያ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ የሆነው ያንዴክስ በዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃቶች በሁለት ዋና ዋና የመረጃ ማዕከላት ላይ ጉዳት በመድረሱ የአገልግሎት መስተጓጎል አጋጥሞታል። እነዚህ ማዕከላት የኩባንያውን የፍለጋ ሞተር፣ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት እና ዘመናዊ የቤት መገልገያ መሳሪያዎችን ለማስኬድ እጅግ ወሳኝ ናቸው። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በሩሲያ ለሚደርስባቸው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት እና የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማዳከም እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teeknoolojii guddichi Raashiyaa Yaandeeks, buufataaleen odeeffannoo isaa lama weerara xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drone) Yukreeniin miidhamuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoo tajaajilaa mudateera. Buufataaleen kunneen sirna barbaaddoo (search engine), 'artificial intelligence' fi meeshaalee mana keessaa to’achuuf baay'ee barbaachisoo dha. Mootummaan Yukreen akka jedhetti, weerarri kun haleellaa Raashiyaan isaanirra geessisaa turteef deebii kennuufi dandeettii waraana Raashiyaa dadhabsiisuuf kan raawwatame dha.

title: European states, Canada, Japan and UN back ICC against US sanctions
english: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC), aiming to block its operations and prevent the prosecution of American citizens. In response, several key US allies, including European nations, Canada, and Japan, have joined the United Nations in condemning the move. These countries and the ICC itself view the sanctions as a dangerous attack on the global rule of law and have pledged to protect the court’s independence.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) ላይ ማዕቀብ የጣለች ሲሆን፣ ይህም የፍርድ ቤቱን ስራ ለማስተጓጎል እና የአሜሪካ ዜጎች በችሎት እንዳይጠየቁ ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። ለዚህ ድርጊት ምላሽ ለመስጠት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት፣ ካናዳ፣ ጃፓን እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ውሳኔውን አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት እና ፍርድ ቤቱ ራሱ፣ ማዕቀቡ በአለም አቀፍ የህግ የበላይነት ላይ የተቃጣ ጥቃት መሆኑን በመግለጽ የፍርድ ቤቱን ነጻነት ለመጠበቅ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Mana Maree Yakka Adunyaa (ICC) irratti sagantaa adabbiiwwan dinagdee kan kute yoo ta'u, kunis hojii mana marichaa gufachiisuufi lammiilee Ameerikaa himannaa irraa ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Gocha kana ilaalchisee, biyyoonni michoota Ameerikaa ta'an kan akka Awurooppaa, Kaanaadaa, Jaappaaniifi Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii mormii cimaa agarsiisaniiru. Biyyoonni kunniinifi mana marichi ofiinuu, adabbiin kun seera adunyaa irratti haleellaa cimaa akka ta'e ibsuun, bilisummaa mana marichaa eeguuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Tsunami warnings across Latin America after 7.7 magnitude earthquake hits
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck southern Panama, causing significant tremors and structural damage to buildings in the area. In response, authorities have issued tsunami warnings for several nations across Central and South America, including Colombia, Ecuador, and Chile. Residents have evacuated affected areas as emergency officials monitor the coastline for potential waves.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፓናማ የደረሰው 7.7 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በበርካታ ህንጻዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ይህንን ተከትሎ ኮሎምቢያን፣ ኢኳዶርን እና ቺሊን ጨምሮ በበርካታ የላቲን አሜሪካ ሀገራት ላይ የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ተላልፏል። ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናትም የባህር ወለል እንቅስቃሴን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Sokkoo lafaa cimaa hamma 7.7 ta'een Kibba Paanaamaatti erga mudatee booda, miidhaan garagaraa bulchiinsa sana keessatti dhaqqabeera. Haala kanaan walqabatee biyyoota Ameerikaa Laatiin kan akka Kolombiyaa, Ekuwoador fi Chiilii dabalatee akeekkachiisni suunaamii labsameera. Ummanni naannichaa iddoo ofiirraa akka fagaatan ta'uun, mootummoonnis sochiin galaanaa maal akka fakkaatu hordofaa jiru.

title: Injured Orangutan rescued from Indonesia wildfires
english: A young orangutan was saved after being caught in wildfires on the Indonesian island of Borneo. The animal sustained burn injuries to its limbs and is currently recovering at a veterinary facility. Many other orangutans have also been rescued as the spreading fires continue to destroy their natural forest habitat.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ቦርንዮ ደሴት በተከሰተ የደን ቃጠሎ የተጎዳች ወጣት ኦራንጉታን መዳን ችላለች። እንስሳቱ በእጆቿ እና በእግሮቿ ላይ የቃጠሎ ጉዳት ስለደረሰባት በአሁኑ ወቅት የእንስሳት ህክምና ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ህክምና እየተደረገላት ትገኛለች። የደን ቃጠሎው የበርካታ ኦራንጉታኖችን መኖሪያ በማውደሙ ብዙዎቹ ለህልፈት ከመዳረጋቸው በፊት ታድገዋል።
oromo: Orangutanin tokko qarqara bosonaa Indonesia, Borneo irratti ibidda ka'een miidhamee fayyuu danda'eera. Bineensichi harkaafi miilla isaa irratti miidhaan gubaa irra ga'ee, amansi hospitaala bineensotaatti wal'aanamaa jira. Ibiddichi iddoo jireenya bineensotaa kanaa mancaasuu hordofee, orangutanonni hedduun biroon lubbuun baraaramaa jiru.

title: Katie Zacharia ‘offered’ position as White House press secretary
english: President Donald Trump has reportedly offered the role of White House press secretary to conservative commentator Katie Zacharia. Zacharia, who currently serves as a senior communications adviser for Trump Media and Technology Group, previously worked at the Department of Homeland Security. She will fill the vacancy left by Karoline Leavitt, who resigned from the position this past August.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዋይት ሃውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊነት ቦታውን ለወግ አጥባቂዋ አስተያየት ሰጪ ኬቲ ዘካሪያ እንደሰጡ ተዘግቧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የትራምፕ ሚዲያ እና ቴክኖሎጂ ግሩፕ ከፍተኛ የግንኙነት አማካሪ ሆነው በማገልገል ላይ ያሉት ዘካሪያ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም በአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መምሪያ ሰርተዋል። እሳቸውም ካሮሊን ሌቪት ባለፈው ነሐሴ ወር ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ ክፍት የነበረውን ቦታ ይረከባሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp bakka bu'aa sagalee mootummaa (press secretary) Mana Maree Adii akka taatuuf gorsituu fi yaada kennituu konservativii Keetii Zaakaariyaaf dhiheessuun isaanii himameera. Keetiin yeroo ammaa gorsituu quunnamtii ol'aantuu kan taate Traamp Meediyaa fi Teeknooloojii Gireep keessatti yoo ta'u, kanaan dura Ministeera Nageenya Biyyaalessaa keessatti hojjetteerti. Isheenis bakka Kaaroliin Leevit ji'a Hagayyaa darbe gadi dhiifte bu'uun itti gaafatamummaa kana ni fudhatti.

title: ‘Barbaric’: US lawmakers condemn plan to livestream Nidal Hasan’s execution
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing strong backlash from both Republican and Democratic lawmakers over his plan to livestream the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan. Hasan, a former Army officer responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, is scheduled to be executed by a firing squad in December. Critics argue that broadcasting the execution is barbaric, inappropriate, and un-American, insisting that the focus should remain on justice rather than creating a public spectacle.
amharic: የአሜሪካው መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ፣ የኒዳል ሃሳንን የሞት ፍርድ በቀጥታ ስርጭት ለማስተላለፍ ያቀዱት እቅድ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። በ2009 የፎርት ሁድ ጥቃትን የፈጸመው የቀድሞው ወታደራዊ ዶክተር ኒዳል ሃሳን፣ በሚቀጥለው ታህሳስ ወር በጥይት እንዲገደል ተወስኗል። ተቺዎች ይህን ድርጊት አሰቃቂ እና ለአሜሪካ እሴቶች የማይመጥን በማለት በመተቸት፣ ትኩረቱ የህግ ፍትህ ላይ እንጂ በይፋዊ መዝናኛ ላይ መሆን እንደሌለበት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa Pheet Heegseet, ajjeechaa Nidal Haasan jedhamuu kan gara fuulduraatti raawwatamu viidiyoo qajeelaan (livestream) akka darbu karoorsuun isaanii mormii cimaa paartilee lameen irraa isaan mudateera. Nidal Haasan, kan bara 2009 buufata waraanaa Fort Hood irratti namoota ajjeese, ji'a Muddeetti rasaasaan akka ajjeefamu murtaa'eera. Mormitoonni gocha kana akka fokkataa fi kan seera Ameerikaa waliin hin deemneetti kan ilaalan yoo ta'u, xiyyeeffannaan mirga namoota miidhamanii kabajuu irratti malee, akka agarsiisaa uummataatti ilaalchisuu irratti ta'uu hin qabu jedhaniiru.

title: Two killed in Saudi strike on Sanaa airport, Houthi media says
english: Saudi military airstrikes hit the airport in Sanaa, Yemen, resulting in two deaths. This attack occurred just one day after Houthi forces launched their own strikes on a Saudi airport that killed three people. Additionally, Yemeni authorities reported that the Saudi bombardment caused several fires, including the destruction of a local factory.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈፀመው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረው ሶስት ሰዎችን ከገደሉ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ነው። በተጨማሪም የሳውዲ ጥቃቶች በከተማዋ የተለያዩ ቦታዎች ላይ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትለው ፋብሪካን ጨምሮ በርካታ ንብረቶች እንዲወድሙ ማድረጉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Saudii buufata xiyyaaraa Sanaa, kan magaalaa guddoo Yaman irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni lama lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko dura gareen Huutii buufata xiyyaaraa Saudii irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni sadii erga du'anii booda. Kana malees, haleellaa Saudiin qaqqabeen magaala sana keessatti ibidda ka'ee qabeenyaa fi warshaan tokko barbadaa'uu gabaasameera.

title: Trump says Russia to immediately supply diesel fuel ahead of midterms
english: Following a successful meeting with President Putin, Donald Trump announced that Russia will begin shipping millions of tonnes of diesel to help stabilize the global market. The US Treasury has authorized this supply through a temporary permit to help combat record-high fuel costs. This initiative aims to address rising diesel prices just before the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሩሲያው አቻቸው ከቭላድሚር ፑቲን ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ ሩሲያ ለዓለም ገበያ የናፍጣ ነዳጅ እንደምትልክ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት ይህ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እንዲከናወን ጊዜያዊ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምርጫ ወቅት እየጨመረ የመጣውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ለማረጋጋት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp pirezidaant Putiin waliin marii erga godhaniin booda, Raashiyaan gabaa addunyaaf boba'aa diiseelii akka ergitu beeksisaniiru. Waajjirri Qabeenyaa Ameerikaa boba'aan kun gabaa addunyaa akka gahu hayyama yeroo kenneera. Tarkaanfiin kunis yeroo filannoo dura gatii diiseelii hir'isuuf kan yaadameedha.
